1200: Lemilla ochora. vechach hava rabbi shimon avid, kad hava azil bemata, vahavu chavrayyay azlin avatreh, vechama leintu shepiran, maich eneh, vahava amar lechavrayyay al tifnu.

Vechol man deyistakkal bishpiru deinteta bimama, ate leharehure belelya. vei salik hahu hirhura bisha illavih, abar mishshum vilohe massecha lo taasu lachem. tu, i shimmesh beinteteh bezimna desalik beh hahu hirhura bisha, innun benin deolidu elohe massecha ikrun. veal da ketiv, (Vayikra 19:4) al tifnu el haelilim vilohe massecha lo taasu lachem. ribbi abba amar, asir leh lebar nash leistakkela beelile avoda zara, uvenashe deammin, vela leithanyay minnayyhu, vela leitrappea behu, deasir leh lebar nash leistakkela baatar dela itzterich.

Ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 86:16) pene elay vechanneni tena uzzecha leavdecha, pene elay vechanneni, vechi la hava leh lekudesha berich hu bealma shappira kedavid, deihu amar pene elay vechanneni. ella hachi tanenan, david ochora it leh lekudesha berich hu, vehu memana al kama uchelusin ilain umashshiryayn. vechad bae kudesha berich hu lerachama al alma, istakkal behay david, venahir leh anpin, vehu nahir lealmin, vechayes alma.

Ushepiru dehay david, nahir lealmin kullehu, resheh gulegalta dedahava, itrekimat beshiva tachshite zinin dedahava. veha (tikun 122, yitro 73) ukemuha. vachavivuta dekudesha berich hu lokovleh, umissegiut rechimuta dileh gabbeh, amar leh lekudesha berich hu, deyehdar enoy lokovleh, veyistekal beh. begin deinnun shepiran becholla, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 6:Adonai) hasebbi enayich minnegdi vegomer. hasebbi enayich minnegdi divshaata deillen ayynin mistakkelin beh bekudesha berich hu, keden mitarin belibbeh kistin divlisterae, birchimuta illaa, uvisgiut shalhovita dirchimu illaa legabbeh, amar hasebbi enayich minnegdi, aschar enech listar ochora minni, deinnun mokdin li beshalhove rechimuta. veal da ketiv beh bedavid, (Shmuel 1 16:12) vehu admoni im yefe enayim vetov roi. uvegin hahu david illaa shappira, rechimna vetiuveta dekudesha berich hu leadbeka beh. amar david pene elay vechanneni.

Kegavvna da, (Bereshit 27:27) vayyomer ree reach beni kereach sade asher beracho Adonai. mashma deal immeh im yaakov ginta deeden, deihu sade detappuchin kaddishin. vechi hech yachil ginta deeden leaala immeh, deha ginta deeden kama rav hu befuteya uvearka. kama zinin devayytin illain kaddishin, dargin al dargin, madorin al madorin it tamman.

Ella (Shemot 210 amud bet) ginta ochora illaa kaddisha it leh lekudesha berich hu, vehahu ginta rechimuta dileh, veitdevak beh, vela itnetir ella lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy, dehu ayel beh. veda achasin kudesha berich hu leishtakkecha tadir immehon detzaddikayyay. vekol shekken leishtakkecha beh beyaakov, veda zammin leh kudesha berich hu lealaa immeh lesayyeya leh.

Kegavvna da, (Bereshit 28:13) ani Adonai elohe avraham avicha vilohe yitzchak haaretz vegomer. tenan, melammed shenitkappela lo eretz yisrael. vechi eretz yisrael, deihi 4 meot parsa al 4 meot parsa, hech itakarat meatrah, veyatva techotoy. ella eretz ochora illaa kaddisha it lekudesha berich hu, veeretz yisrael ikre. vehi techot darga deyaakov dekaim alah. veachasin lah kudesha berich hu leyisrael begin rechimuta dilhon, ledayyeyra immehon, uledabbera lehon, uleaggana lehon mikkola, veikre eretz chayyim.

Ta chaze, asir leh levar nash, leistakkela baatar dekudesha berich hu mais beh, urechika beh nafsheh. uma bema derachim kudesha berich hu, asir leistakkela beh, bema derachik al achat kamma vechamma. deta chaze, asir leh levar nash leistakkela bakkeshet, begin deihu chezo dediyyukena illaa. asir leh levar nash leistakkela beat kayyayma dileh, begin dehu ramiz letzaddika dealma. asir leh levar nash leistakkela, beetzbean dechahane, beshaata defarse yedayyhu, begin detamman sharya yekara demalka illaa. uma baatar kaddisha illaa asir
1201: Leistakkela, baatar misava rechika la kol shekken. begine kach, al tifnu el haelilim. ribbi yitzchak amar, uma leistakkela behu asir, lemiflach lehu, o lemebad lehu, al achat kama vechamma.

Uvegine kach, al tifnu el haelilim. hacha ata leazhara lehu leyisrael kekadmeta. lokovel (Shemot 20:3) lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay. vilohe massecha lo taasu lachem, lokovel lo taase lecha fesel ani Adonai elohechem. lokovel anochi Adonai elohecha, ish immo veaviv tirau. lokovel kabbed et avicha veet immecha. veet shabbetotay tishmoru, zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. lo tishshavu vishmi lashshaker. lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav. lo tignovu, lo tignov. velo techachashu, velo teshakkeru ish baamito. lo taane vereacha ed shaker. mot yumat hannoef vehannoafet, lo tinaf. lo taamod al dam reecha, lo tirtzach. veha ukemuha, veal da kelala deorayyta, befarsheta da.

Amar ribbi chiyay, bekadmita, anochi Adonai elohecha. zachor et yom hashshabbat. lo tissa. lo tirtzach. lo tinaf. lo tignov. belishana yechiday. vehacha, ani Adonai elohechem. ish immo veaviv tirau, veet shabbetotay tishmoru. al tifnu el haelilim. belishana desaggiin. ella ta chaze, miyyoma dahavo yisrael shechichin bealma, la ishtechachu kame kudesha berich hu, belibba chad, uviruta chada, kema behahu yoma dekayymu betura desinay. veal da kolla ittemar belashon yechiday. levatar belishana desaggiin, deha la ishtechachu kol kach behahu reuta.

Ribbi elazar hava azil lemecheme leribbi yose berabbi shimon ben lakuneya chamuy, vahavu immeh ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, kad matu chad be chakal, yatvu techot ilana chada. amar ribbi elazar, kol chad lema milla deorayyta. patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Hoshea 13:4) veanochi Adonai elohecha meeretz mitzrayim vilohim zulati lo teda. la ketiv asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim, ella anochi Adonai elohecha meeretz mitzrayim, vechi meeretz mitzrayim hava lehu malka, vela mikkadmat dena, veha ketiv (Bereshit 35:2) vayyomer yaakov el banav hasiru et elohe hannechar asher betochchem. uchetiv (Bereshit 35:3) venakuma venaale bet el, veat amrat meeretz mitzrayim.

Ella, min yoma dahavo yisrael bealma, la ishtemodau yekara dekudesha berich hu. bar beara demitzrayim, dahavu behahu pulechana kashya, vetzavvchu lokovleh, vela ishtannu minnimusa dilhon lealmin. vetamman itbechinu avhatana, kidahava miggo shafcha. (sefer acher kaftora dedahava miggo tifsa) veod, dahavo chaman bechol yoma, kama charshin, kama zinin bishin, leataa lon livne nasha, vela satu mearcha limina velismala. veaf al gav dela havo yade kol kach bikara dekudesha berich hu, ella havo azlin batar nimuse avahathon.

Ulevatar, chamu kama nissin, vechamma gevuran, venatal lon kudesha berich hu lefulechaneh. uvegin dechullehu chamu kama nissin veatin beenehon, vechol innun atin ugevuran. amar veanochi Adonai elohecha meeretz mitzrayim. detamman hava beitgalyay yekara dileh. veitgele alayyhu al yamma, vechamu ziv yekara illaa dileh appin beappin. dela temrun elaha ochora hu demallil immana, ella ana hu dachamitun beara demitzrayim, ana hu dekatalna sanechon beara demitzrayim. ana hu deavedna kol innun eser mechaan beara demitzrayim. uvegine kach, vilohim zulati lo teda, dela tema deochora hava, ella ana hu kolla.

Tu patach, (Vayikra 19:13-14) lo taashok et reacha velo tigzol lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker. lo talin peullat sachir amay. ella mikkera ochora ishtema, dichtiv, (Devarim 24:15) beyomo titten secharo velo tavo alav hashshemesh ki ani hu veelav hu nose et nafsho. lo tavo alav hashshemesh, izdehar dela titkenish beginoy mealma, ad la yimte zimnach leitkannesha. kema deat amer, (Kohelet 12:2) ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh vegomer. mehacha olifna milla ochora, man deashlim lenafsha demiskena. afillu
1202: Dematu yomoy leistalleka mealma, kudesha berich hu ashlim lenafsheh, veyahiv leh chayyin yattir.

Lo talin peullat sachir, ta chaze, man denatil agra demiskena, keillu natil nafsheh, udeanshe beteh. hu azar nafshayyhu, kudesha berich hu azir yomoy, veazar nafsheh, mehahu alma. deha kol innun havalim denafke mippumeh, kol hahu yoma, kullehu sallekin kammeh dekudesha berich hu, vekayymin kammeh, levatar salleka nafsheh, venafshayyhu deanshe beteh, vekayymin, beinnun havalim defumeh. ucheden, afillu itgezar al hahu bar nash kama yomin, vechamma tavan, kullehu mitakkeran minneh, umistalke minneh.

Velo od, ella denafsha dileh la salleka leella, vehayeynu deamar ribbi abba, rachamana lishezvinan minnayyhu, umeelbonayyhu. veokmuha afillu ashir hu, veelav hu nose et nafsho dayyka, afillu mikkol bar nash name, vekol shekken miskena. vehayeynu dehava rav hamenuna avid, kad hava hahu agir mistelak meavidteh, hava yahiv leh agreh, veamar leh, tol nafshach deafkidat biday, tol pikdonach.

Vaafillu amar yehe bidach, daana (lo) baena lesalleka agri. la hava bae. amar pikdona degufach, la itchaze leitpakda bidi, kol shekken pikdona denafsha. deha pikdona denafsha la ityehivat, ella lekudesha berich hu. dichtiv, (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi, amar ribbi chiyyay, uvida deochora share. amar leh, afillu bideh, batar deyahiv.

Ketiv lo talin peullat sachir, uchetiv velo tavo alav hashshemesh. ella ha ukemuha, aval ta chaze let lach yoma veyoma, dela shalta beh yoma illaa ochora. vei ihu la yahiv leh nafsha dileh behahu yoma, keman defagim lehahu yoma illaa. uvegine kach beyomo titten secharo, velo tavo alav hashshemesh. veha deittemar lo talin, begin denafsheh la salik, vesalik hahu nafsha demiskena, udeanshe beteh, kema deittemar.

Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar kera avatreh, (Vayikra 19:14) lo tekallel cheresh velifne ivvir vegomer, hay kera kemashmao. aval parsheta da, kolla olifna minnah millin ochoranin, vechullehu talyayn da beda. ta chaze, man delayit lechavreh, veihu kammeh, veachsif leh, keillu oshid dameh, veha okimna. vehay kera, delav chavreh immeh, vehu layit leh, hahi milla salleka.

Delet lach milla umilla denafik mippumeh, dela it leh kala, hahu kala salik leella, vechamma kasterin mitchabberan immeh dehahu kala, ad desalleka veittear atar dithoma rabba, kema deukemuha vechamma mitarin aleh dehahu bar nash. vavy leman deappik milla bisha mippumeh, veha ukemuha.

Velifne ivvir lo titten michshol, kemashmao. veukemuha, beman degarim leochora lemechete. vechen man demache livreh rabba. velifne ivvir lo titten vegomer, beman dela mata lehoraa veore, (kema deat amar) dichtiv, (Mishlei 7:26) ki rabbim chalalim hippila vaatzumim kol harugeha. vehay abar, mishshum velifne ivvir lo titten michshol, begin deachshil leh lechavreh lealma deate.

Detanenan man deazil beorach meshar beorayyta, uman deishtedal beorayyta kedka yaut, it leh chulaka tava tadir lealma deate. dehahi milla deorayyta deappik mippumeh, azla veshaata bealma, vesalleka leella. vechamma illain kaddishin mitchabberan behahi milla, vesalleka beorach meshar, veitattar beitra kaddisha, veistache benahara dealma deate, denagid venafik meeden, veitkabbal beh, veishteav begavih, veitannag (sefer acher vaatanetaa) socharaneh dehahu nahara, ilana illaa. ucheden nagid venafik nehora illaa veitattar beh behahu bar nash kol yoma, kema deittemar. (yitro 57 amud alef).
Uman delae (nusach acher deyalef) beorayyta, vela ishtaddal bah beorach keshot,
1203: Uveorach meshar. hahu milla salleka, vesate orchin, velet man deyitchabbar bah, vecholla dachyyayn lah levar, veazil veshat bealma vela yishkach atar. man garim leh hay. hahu desate leh meorach meshar, hada hu dichtiv velifne ivvir lo titten michshol. uvegine kach ketiv, veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai.

Uman detiuvete lemile beorayyta, vela ashkach man deyolif leh, vehu birchimuta deorayyta, lae bah, umegamgem bah, begimguma dela yada. kol milla umilla salleka, vekudesha berich hu chadde behahi milla, vekabbil lah, venata lah sacharaneh dehahu nachala, veitavidu meillen millin ilanin ravrevin, veikrun arve nachal, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:19) beahavatah tishge tamid.

Vedavid malka amar, (Tehillim 86:11) horeni Adonai darkecha ahalech baamittecha. uchetiv (Tehillim 27:11) unecheni beorach mishor lemaan shorray. zakkain innun deyadin orchoy deorayyta, umishtaddele bah beorach meshar, deinnun natin ilanin dechayyin leella, dechullehu asuvta. uvegin kach ketiv, (Malachi 2:6) torat emet hayta befihu. vechi it tora delav ihi emet. in kegavvna deamaran, deore man dela yada, velav ihu keshot vehahu deolif milla mineh, olif milla delav ihu emet. uvegine kach ketiv, torat emet hayta befihu.

Veim kol da, mibbae leh levar nash lemelaf mille deorayyta mikkol bar nash, afillu mimman dela yada. begin deal da yittear beorayyta, veyete lemelaf mimman deyada, ulevatar ishtechach, deazil bah beorayyta beorach keshot. ta chaze, yishtedal bar nash bealma beorayyta ufikkudoy, afillu dela avid lishmah, demittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah.

Ribbi yose patach kera avatreh veamar, (Vayikra 19:15) lo taasu avl bammishpat vegomer. lo taasu avl bammishpat, kemashmao. aval ha ittemar, defarsheta da millin illain veyakkirin it bah befikkude orayyta. hay kera missofeh ka mashma, dichtiv betzedek tishpot amitecha. ta chaze, tere dargin innun hacha: mishpat, vetzedek. ma ben hay lehay. ella chad rachame, vechad dina, veda itbesam beda.

Kad ittear tzedek, dain dina lecholla kachada, delet beh rachame, velav vavtranuta. kad ittear mishpat, it beh rachame. yachol yehe kolla bemmishpat. ata kera veamar, betzedek tishpot amitecha. may tama. begin detzedek lav dain leda veshavik leda, ella kullehu kachada beshikkula chada. kegavvna da lo tissa fene dal velo tehdar pene gadol, ella kullehu beshikkula chada, betzedek. yachol yehe kolla dina betzedek bilchodoy. ata kera veamar tishpot, devae lechabbera lehu kachada, dela yishtekach da bela da, vehay shelimu dedina.

Vekol kach lamma. begin dekudesha berich hu shechiach tamman. uvegine kach bae leashlema dina. kegavvna deihu avid letatta, kegavvna dileh mammash avid leella. veta chaze, kudesha berich hu shavvi kuresyay dedina, beshaata dedayayne yatvin, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 9:8) konen lemishpat kiso. umittamman ittakkan kuresya dekudesha berich hu. uman ihu kuresya. illen innun tzedek umishpat. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:15) tzedek umishpat mechon kisecha. uman dedain dina, bae lemedan (sefer acher lemetav) bechuresye demalka. vei pagim chad minnayyhu, keillu pagim lechureseh demalka. ucheden kudesha berich hu istellak mibbenayyhu dedayyne, vela kaim bedinayyhu. umay amar. (Tehillim 12:6) atta akum yomar Adonai vegomer. verucha dekudesha amar, (Tehillim 57:6) ruma al hashshamayim elohim.

Raya mehemna (Vayikra 19:17) lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha hocheach tochiach et amitecha vegomer. pikkuda da, leochacha lehahu dechate, lemechezi leh rechimu sagya, derachim leh, begin dela yitanash ihu. deha bekudesha berich hu ketiv, (Mishlei 3:12) ki et asher yeehav Adonai yochiach. uchemma dekudesha berich hu avid veochach leman derachim leh, hachi yolif bar nash mehahu archa, veyochach lechavreh. kudesha berich hu bemay ochach lebar nash. ochach leh birchimu besitra, i yekabbel leh yaut. vei la, ochach leh ben rechimoy. i yekabbel yaut. vei la, ochach leh beitgalyay leenehon decholla. i yekabbel yaut. vei lav, shari leh, vela ochach leh, veshavik
1204: Bekadmita oda leh besitra, begin leochacha leh, uleitara leh, dela yinneda beh bar nash. veda ihu beneh leveneh. i mekabbel yaut. vei lav, oda leh ben rechimoy, bezimna dechahana rabba hava bealma, yahiv leh marin bearseh, veatu rechimoy dekudesha berich hu, veodan leh, i it beh chova deyetuv minneh, uleayen bemileh. i mekabbel yaut, vei lav ochach leh beitgalyay, bemamoneh, bivnoy, decholla melachashan aleh, veyitun legabbeh. i mekabbel yaut. vei lav share leh mareh lemebad reuteh, vela yatkif beh lealmin. kegavvna da itztzetrich leh leochacha lechavreh bekadmita besitra. levatar ben rechimoy. levatar beitgalyay. mikkan ulehala yishbok leh veyabid reuteh.

Veal da ketiv hocheach tochiach. hocheach: besitra, dela yinneda beh bar nash. tochiach: ben chavroy urechimoy. et amitecha: beitgalyay. veal da la ketiv bekadmita tochiach, ella hocheach. tu hocheach, i ihu bar nash deyichsuf, la yimma leh vela yochiach leh afillu besitra, ella yimma kammeh, keman demishtae bemillin ochoranin. uvego innun millin, yidkar man deavad hahu chova hu kach vechach, begin deihu yeda begarmeh, veyishtevik mehahu chova. veal da hocheach. veim lav, tochiach. ulevatar et amitecha beitgalyay. mikkan ulehala velo tissa alav chet.

Davar acher velo tissa alav chet, deha kevan debar nash ochach lechavreh, veizdeman leochacha leh beitgalya, la yesallek kammeh hahu chova daaved, deasir leh vaday, ella yemma setam, vela yesallek aloy hahu chova beitgalyay, vela yarshim aloy chova, dekudesha berich hu chas al yekara devar nash, afillu bechayyayvaya. (ad kan raya mehemana) (pikkuda 18 levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu vechulei 270 amud bet)

Patach veamar, vayhi kol hashshofar holech vegomer. vayhi kol hashshofar, hacha itpeligu sifre kadmae vechulei, ad deatu ribbi abba veribbi yehuda, veodu leh leribbi acha. (amar hamegayh matzati katuv kan ze hammaamar vayyaan shekkevar havedapes parashat Vayikra daf 6 amud bet shura 22 vamesayym baddaf 8 amud alef shura 26, lo ratziti lahedapeysev paam shenit)

Kamu, ad dahavu azle, amar ribbi elazar lo telech rachil beammecha lo tisna et achicha lo tikkom velo tittor. ha okimna lon, vechullehu ataru alayyhu chavrayyay, aval nema milla befarshata da, ketiv, et chukkotay tishmoru behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra kilayim uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Yeshayahu 43:10) attem eday neum Adonai veavdi asher bacharti lemaan tedu vetaaminu vegomer. attem eday, illen innun yisrael. vetanenan, illen innun shemayya veara, dichtiv (Devarim 30:19) haidoti vachem hayyom et hashshamayim veet haaretz. aval yisrael innun sahadin illen al illen, ushemaya veara vecholla, sahadin alayyhu. veavdi asher bacharti, da yaakov, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar, uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 30:10) veatta al tira avdi yaakov. veit deamre da david. vedavid avdi ikre, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 37:35) lemaani ulemaan david avdi asher bacharti, da david illaa.

Lemaan tedu vetaaminu li vetavinu ki ani hu. may ki ani hu. deitraiti behahu david, uvehahu yaakov. ana, hu mammash. lefanay lo notzar el, detanenan, kera kudesha berich hu leyaakov el, dichtiv, (Bereshit 33:20) vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael. kudesha berich hu kara leyaakov el. hada hu dichtiv, lefanay lo notzar el veacharay lo yihye. uvegin kach, ani hu. kolla kema deittemar. veacharay lo yihye, deha david hachi ikre, velav it batreh ochora.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, atkin kol milla umilla, kol chad vechad besitroy. umane alayyhu chelin illain. velet lacha afillu isba zeera beara, delet leh chela illaa leella. vechol ma deavdin bechol chad vechad, (tere navesachey) vechol ma dechol chad vechad avid, kolla hu bitkifu dehahi chela illaa, dimmana aleh leella. vechullehu nimusin gezirin middina, al dina natlin, veal dina kayymin. let man denafik
1205: Vechullehu memanan, min yoma deitbere alma, mitpakdan shiltonin al kol milla umilla. vechullehu natlin al nimusa ochora illaa, denatlin kol chad vechad. kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. kevan denatlin hahu chok, kullehu ikrun chukkot, vehahu chok deityeyhiv lehu, min shemayya ka ate, ucheden itkerun chukkot shamayim. umenalan demin shamayim ka atyayn. dichtiv (Tehillim 81:5) ki chok leyisrael hu.

Veal da ketiv, et chukkotay tishmoru begin dechol chad vechad memana al milla yedia bealma, behahu chok. begin kach asir lemichlaf zinin, uleaala zina bezina ochora. begin deaakar lechol chela vechela meatrayyhu, (achchish pamalya shel maale) veachchish pumebi demalka.

Kilayim, mahu kilayim. keman deyahiv ochora beve matra, kema deat amer (yirmeya 37) el bet hakkele, begin dela lemebad midi. kilayim: meniuta, demana lechol innun chelin meavidata dilhon. kilayim: irbuveyay, deavid irbuveya bechela dilella, veachchish pumebi demalka, kema deittemar, (uvegin kach) uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Bereshit 2:17) umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu ki beyom achalcha mimmennu mot tamut. veha ittemar, deshane pikkudoy demalka, veachlaf etz chayyim, deveh ishtelim kolla, uveh talya mehemnuta, veitdevak baatar ochora. veha tanenan, becholla bae bar nash leachazaa ovada kegavvna dilella, ulemebad ovada kema deitzterich. vei ishtanne bemilla ochora, hu angid aleh lesharya beh milla ochora dela itzterich.

Veta chaze, beshaata devar nash achze ovada letatta beorach meshar, kema deitzterich, nagid venafik vesharya aloy ruach kadisha illaa. uveshaata deihu achze ovada letatta beorcha akima, delet ihu orach meshar, keden nagid venafik veshare aloy ruach ochora, dela itzterich, desate leh lebar nash listar bish. man mashich aleh hahu rucha. havi omer, hahu ovada deachze bistar ochora.

Ketiv (Mishlei 31:13) darsha tzemer ufishtim. darsha, mahu darsha. devaya vedarish al tzemer ufishtim, man dimchabber lon kachada, vei tema betzitzit amay share. ha ukemuha. aval hatam hu hahu levusha betikkunoy, beashlemut ovada kadka chaze.

(Nusach acher veda) tu, darsha tzemer ufishtim, lemebad nukema beman dimchabber lon kachada. aval ematay sharya. beshaata deihu beashlemuta, dichtiv, vattaas bechefetz kafeha. vetzitzit, ha okimna dehatam behahu kelala dishlemuta ishtechach, vela avid middi. aval beshaata dela ishtechach bishlemuta, man deate lechabbera lon kachada, itar aleh rucha dela itzterich.

Milla da man ochach. kayin vehevel ochchan. deda ate missitra chad, veda ate missitra ochora. uvegin kach la live lan lechabbera lon kachada. (sefer acher 33 milla da man ochach. kayin vehevel ochachan) vekarbena dekayin, itrechak mikkamme karbena dehevel.

Veal da uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha. lo yaale alecha setam, lo yaale alecha rucha ochora leshalletaa bach. veitzterich leh levar nash leachazaa ovada dechashra kema deyaut, uvehahu ovada sharya aleh ruach kadisha, ruach illaa, leitkaddesha beh, ata leitkaddesha mekaddeshin leh, dichtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai.

Ketiv umeetz haddaat tov vara, uma al da garim adam mita bealma, man deachze ovada ochora dela itzterich, al achat kama vechamma. shor vachamor ochachan. missitra da ikre shor, umissitra da ikre chamor, veal da ketiv (Devarim 22:10-11) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav. la taavid irbuveyay kachada, begin deitar leitchabbera sitra ochora kachada, leavasha alma. uman defarish lon, asge shelama bealma. uf hacha, man defarish lon behahu gavvna kema deamru, dela ishtechach shua
1206: Tavuy venuz kachada, hay bar nash asge shelama aleh, veal kol alma.

Karbena dekayin hava pishtim, vekarbena dehevel hava tzemer, lav da keda, velav da keda. raza demilla, kayin kilayim hava, irbuveya dela itzterich, sitra ochora, dela zina dechavva veadam. vekurebaneh mehahu sitra ka atya. hevel mizina chada deadam vechavva. uvemeaha dechavva itchabbaru illen teren sitrin. uvegin deitchabbaru kachada, la atya minnayyhu toalta lealma, vitavidu.

Vead yoma den, sitra dilhon kayyeyma. uman deachze garmeh beovada dechibbura da, ittear aleh innun sitrin kachada, veyachil leitzeka, veshari aloy rucha ochora, dela itzterich. veyisrael baan leitteara alayyhu rucha kaddisha lemehevi kaddishin, leishtakkecha bishlama, bealma den uvealma deate.

Ketiv (Vayikra 6:3) velavash hakkohen mido vad umichnese bad yihyu al besaro (uvaavnet bad ychegaver) amay ikre bad, yechiday. begin dela bae lechabbera lehay pishtim beochora, veal da la ketiv mido fishtim, ella vad yechidaa.

Vechahana amay ihu bae leitchazaa behay. ella illen mane bad, bae leitchazaa behu al mizbach haola, kad hava mafne kitra (sefer acher kitma) dedishna deola, deha ola missitra deavoda zara vehirhura bisha ka atya. uvegin kach, bae leitchazaa behu bilchodayyhu, vela beirbuveya kema deamaran, begin deyitkappar leh lebar nash kol innun chovin deatyayn mehahu sitra.

Vechad ayel lemakdesha, atar dishlimu ishtechach, vechol innun pulechane dishlemuta, af al gav deitchabbaru, let lan bah, kema deamaran betzitzit, begin detamman ishtechachu veitchabberu kol innun zayyeynin dilella, vechol innun mane makdesha, mishtakkechin beh kama zayyeynin meshanneyayn da min da, vechullehu itkelilu tamman kegavvna dilella. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahiv lehu orayyta dikshot, orayyta dimhemnuta, vericham lehu mikkol shear ammin ovde avoda zara, dichtiv, (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai.

Patach ribbi chiyyay avatreh veamar, chi tavou el haaretz unetatem kol etz maachol vegomer. uvashshana harviit yihye kol piryo kodesh hillulim laAdonai. chi tavou el haaretz, ha ukemuha chavrayyay, aval ta chaze, deha ilana la avid perin, ella beara. veara appik lehon, veachze hahu ibba lealma. veara la avda perin ella miggo chela ochora dealah. kema denukeba la avda perin, ella miggo chela didchura.

Vehahu ibba, la ishtelim beashlemuta, ad telat shenin. vechela la itpakda aleh leella ad deishtelim. batar deishtelim itpakda aleh chela veara ittekanat beh. deha ad telat shenin ara la ittekanat beh vela (ishtechachat) ishtelimat (sefer acher atebasemat) (nusach acher asetakemat) immeh. batar deishtelim veittekanu kachada keden hu shelemuta.

Ta chaze, nukeba, ad telat zimnin deitabbera, ibba dimaha la ishtelim. batar 3 iduan, nukeba ittekanat behahu ibba, veistekamu kachada. keden hahu ibba shelimu decholla, ushepiru decholla. batar denafak, ad 3 shenin la it leh chela leella, deha keden ishtelim bishula dileh. levi itree mikkolla, telitaa leimeh, deittakkanat beh, veistakkemat sefer acher (vaatabesamet) bahadeh.

Batar 3 shenin, itpekkadat aleh (sefer acher itpekad ala) chela illaa leella. uvashshana harviit, yihye kol piryo kodesh hillulim. may kodesh hillulim. tushebchan, leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu. ad hacha. mikkan veelach raza demilla, devashshana
1207: Harviit mizdevvavgat keneset yisrael lekudesha berich hu, vehillula chad ishtechach. dichtiv kodesh hillulim, hilula vechedva bezimna (sefer acher beziuuga) chada.

May shana (harviit) da kudesha berich hu. vetanenan, shana harviit, da keneset yisrael deihi kayyeyma reviaa lechuresyay, vecholla chad, deha keden kudesha berich hu mizdavvavg bah bikkeneset yisrael, ucheden hi kodesh, vehillula kaddisha ishtechach, (vekudesha berich hu izdavvavg bahadah) ucheden chayyaylin itmanan al alma, al kol milla umilla kadka chaze leh mikkan ulehala mitbarchan kullehu, veshari lemechal, deha kullehu bishlemuta decholla, bishlemuta deella vetatta.

Vead la ishtelim becholla mittatta umeella, asir lemechal minneh. uman deachil minneh, keman delet leh chulaka bekudesha berich hu ubbikkeneset yisrael, deha hahu ibba bela reshuta illaa kaddisha kayyeyma, dela share aleh ad deyishtelim. uvela reshuta. tattaa, deha la istakkemat (sefer acher atebasemat) chela deara beh. vehahu deachil minneh, achze garmeh delet leh chulaka leella vetatta, vei barich aleh, beracha levattala hu. deha kudesha berich hu ad kaon la sharya aloy, velet beh chulaka. rachamana lishezvinan meinnun dela mashgichin likara demarehon.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayyay bealma den, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga. begin divhahu zimna, yistalak chivya desharya benukeba bekadmita, veyete dechura lemishre beatreh kad bekadmita, vecholla yehe shelim. tana bezimna dezakkaa share bealma vechulei ad tzaddik kattamar yifrach. (amar hamegayh hammaamar hazze yimtzaehu hameayyn befarashat Vayikra daf 14 amud bet shura 24 umashlim daf 16 amud alef shura 22)

Ribbi yose patach kera veamar, (Vayikra 19:26) lo tochlu al haddam. ha bechamma atar ukemuha chavrayyay, vechol hane kerae avatreh. vechol chad vechad beitgalyay. aval hay kera it leitara beh, dichtiv mippene seva takum vegomer. mippene seva, seva deorayyta setam. takum, mikkan devae bar nash lemekam bekiyyuma (mikkan devae bar nash lemekam) mikkame sefer tora, vehachi rav hamenuna (sefer acher yesa) sava, kad hava chame sefer tora, hava kam mikkammeh, veamar mippene seva takum. (24 hava chame chumash deorayyta hu kam mikkammeh) (sefer acher avid leh hadevarea) (vehave amar vehadarta pene zaken) kegavvna da, bae bar nash lemekam bekiyyumeh lekammeh detalmid chacham, begin deihu kaim bekiyyuma (nusach acher bediyyukena) kaddisha illaa. veramaz lechahana illaa (sefer acher vehacha ramiz laataykaa) kaddisha illaa, dichtiv vehadarta pene zaken, deihu bealma. amar rabbi shimon, mikkan remez letora shebbichtav veremez letora shebbeal pe.

Vetu tanenan, hay kera lidrasha hu deata, mippene seva takum, kema deitaru beh chavrayyay, mippene seva takum, azhar leh levar nash, ad la yistalak besivuta, diykum bekiyyuma tava bealma, begin deden hu hiddura leh, aval lesof yomoy let shevacha leh lebar nash kol kach, kad ihu siv vela yachil lemehevi bish. ella shevacha dileh, kad ihu betukefeh, veihu tav. ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar, (Mishlei 20:11) gam bemaalalav yitnakker naar vegomer. kegavvna da ketiv, (Kohelet 12:1) uzechor et borecha bime bechurotecha. amar ribbi elazar, vadday (hachi hu) orcha da metukkana kaman, vehay orcha dekudesha berich hu.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 1:6) ki yodea Adonai derech tzaddikim vederech reshaim toved. may ki yodea Adonai. ella, kudesha berich hu yodea veashgach bearcha detzaddikayyay, leotava lehu, uleaggana lehu, vehu azil kammayyhu lenatra lehu. uvegin kach, man denafik learcha bae delihevi hahi archa dekudesha berich hu, veyishtattaf leh bahadayyhu. uvegin kach ketiv, ki yodea Adonai derech tzaddikim vederech reshaim toved. hi miggarmah, begin dekudesha berich hu la
1208: Ishtemoda leh lehahu archa dilhon, vela azil bahadayyhu.

Ketiv derech, uchetiv orach, ma ben hay lehay. ella, derech: dishar karsule bene nasha azlu bah. orach: deihu itpetach min zimna zeera (da orach kema deat amar 0 veorach lechavre im poale aven) veal archa da ketiv, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech vaor ad nechon hayyom. amen ken yehi ratzon. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1209: Lekabbela lishchinta. batar denafka, man ihi nafsha deitdabbak bah (sefer acher vetitkabbel) vikabbel begufa (sefer acher begavvav) veha ukemuha lehane mile.

Batar denafka nafsha min gufa, veishtear gufa bela rucha, asir lemishbak leh bela kevurata, dichtiv, (Devarim 21:23) lo talin nivlato al haetz ki kavor tikberenu bayyom hahu. begin demeta deyishtahe 24 shaot, deinnun yomam valayla, bela kevurata, yahiv chalishuta beshayyfoy dirticha, umeakkev avidta dekudesha berich hu millemevad deefshar dekudesha berich hu gazar aleh, begin lemeteh begilgula ochora, miyyad behahu yoma deitpetar, leotava leh. vechol zimna dela itkevar gufa, nishmeta lav alat kame kudesha berich hu, vela yachla lemehevi begufa ochora, begilgula tinyayna, dela yahavin lenishmeta gufa ochora, ad deyitkevar kadmaa. veda dame levar nash demetat itteteh, la itchaze leh, lemesav itteta ochora, ad dekavir lekadmeta, uvegin da amra orayyta, lo talin nivlato al haetz.

Davar acher, kad itparsha nishmeta min gufa, uvaya lemezal lehahu alma, la teul lehahu alma, ad deyahavin lah gufa ochora minnehora, ulevatar yachla lemeal. umeeliyyahu tinda, dahavo leh teren gufin, chad deveh itchaze letatta livne nasha, vechad deveh itchaze leella, ben malachin illain kadishin. vechol kamma degufa la itkevar, tzaara hu lenishmeta, veruach misava izdeman lesharyay aloy, ulesaava lehahu gufa.

Uvegin dehahu ruach misava, izdeman, la live leh leinish, lemevat hahu gufa lelya chad, begin deruach misava ishtechach belelya, veishtetach bechol ara, leashkecha gufa bela nafsha, lesaava leh, veisteav yattir, veal da azhar lechahane veamar, lenefesh lo yittamma beammav, begin deinnun kaddishin la yishre alayyhu ruach misava, vela yistaavun.

(Vayikra 21) emor el hakkohanim, ribbi yitzchak amar, emor el hakkohanim, bilchishu. kema dechol ovadehon dechahane bilchishu, kach amira dilhon bilchishu. emor veamarta: zimna chad, uteren zimnin, leazhara lehu al kedushayyhu, begin dela yistaavun. deman dimshammesh baatar kaddisha, baya deyishtechach kaddisha becholla. lenefesh lo yittamma, kema deokimna, degufa bela ruach, misava hu, veshare aleh ruach misava. deha tiuveta deruche misave legabbe gufehon deyisrael ihu, begin deitterak minnayyhu rucha kaddisha, uvemana dekudesha, atyayn leitchabbera. vechahane deinnun kaddishin, kedushshata al kedushshata, la bayayn leistaava kelal, begin dichtiv, (Bamidbar 6:7) ki nezer elohav al rosho. uchetiv ki shemen mishchat elohav alav ani Adonai.

Vehu kegavvna dilella kaim letatta, dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh yored al hazzakan zekan aharon sheored al pi middotav, hay kera ukemuha, aval kashshemen hattov al harosh, da meshach revut kaddisha illaa, denagid venafik meatar denahara amika decholla. davar acher, denagid venafik meresha dechol reshin, setima dechol setimin. al harosh, al harosh vaday, resha deadam kadmaa.
Yored al hazzakan, da dikna yakira, kema deukemuha. zekan aharon, da kohen gadol dilella, veha ukemuha. vehahu shemen,

Raya mehemna pikuda da, lesaddera kahana bechol yoma butztzinin beve makdesha, veha okimna beraza dimnora. veihu raza kegavvna dilella, begin dinhiru illaa bimshach revu, nachit al resha dechahana bekadmita levatar ihu adlik veanhir kol butztzinin. dichtiv kashshemen hatov al harosh vegomer, uchetiv ki shemen mishchat elohav alav vegomer. veal da ityeyhiv reshu lechahana bilchodoy, lesaddera butztzinin, ulaadlaka lehon bechol yoma teren zimnin, lokovel nehiru deyichuda teren zimnin, karbena bechol yoma, teren zimnin, vecholla itztzetrich.
Veal yede dechahana naharin butztzinin becholla, ella vetatta
1210: Yored al pi midotav, demeinnun meshichan, nagid venafik venachit letattae, uchegavvna da nagid veitattar kahana tattaa, bimshach revut letatta.

Hay kera, lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. ketiv emor el hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem lenefesh lo yittamma. la yittammeu mibbae leh, mahu lo yittamma. ella, al hahu kohen illaa mekullehu kaamar. amar ribbi yehuda veha ketiv vehakkohen haggadol meechav. (kan chaser) ella vadday hachi hu kema deittemar, veamar ribbi yitzchak, kahana dekaim letatta, kegavvna dilella, bikdushsha itzterich leishtakkecha yattir mikkolla, kema deittemar.

Lemechdu cheddu, uleashkecha cheddu bechol sitrin. beadlekuta devutztzinin, deha teren illen al yede dechahana, leishtakkecha chedu bechol sitrin, veillen innun adlekuta devutztzinin uketoret. veha okimna (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev, (ad kan raya mehemana)

(Vayikra 21:3) velaachoto habbetula hakkerova elav vegomer. ma ketiv leella, ki im lishero hakkarov elav vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra vegomer, mi ze ba meedom, zammin kudesha berich hu lelavsha levushe nukema al edom, deacharivu beteh, veokidu hechaleh, vegalu lichneset yisrael bene ammaya. ulemevad lehon nikmat almin, ad deyishtachchun kol turin miture alma, malyayn mikatule ammin, ulemikre lechol ofa dishmayya alayyhu, vechol chevavt bara yitzenun minnayyhu teresar yarche, veofa dishmayya sheva shenin, ad dela tisbal ara niuula didhu. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 34:6) ki zevach laAdonai bevatzra vetevach gadol beeretz edom, ad deinnun levushin yistaavun, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:3) vechol malbushay egalti.

Chamutz begadim mibbatzra, begin deminnah nafku uchelusin dealma, lechayyla al yerushalam, veinnun sharu leokda hechala, uvene edom mefagrin shurin, veramu avne yesoda, hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 137:7) zechor Adonai livne edom vegomer, haomrim aru aru ad hayesod bah.

Ze hadur bilvusho, beinnun levushe denukema dezammin lealbesha. tzoe berov kocho, mahu tzoe. metabbar. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 45:6) ammim tachtecha yippelu vegomer. amru yisrael lishaya, man hu den deyaaved kol kach. patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 63:1) ani medabber bitzdaka, hahu deihu rav lehoshia, hahu dichtiv beh, (Tehillim 33:5) ohev tzedaka umishpat. veihu tzedaka mammash, veihu rav lehoshia.

Vekol kach lamma. begin degarmu likkeneset yisrael lemehevi shechivat leafra begaluta, uleminpal leara, kema dichtiv, (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael. uvegin kach, kudesha berich hu yilbash levushe nukema alayyhu, lesaava lon bisgiu dekatuleyay, dichtiv vechol malbushay egalti.

Vechol kach lamma, dichtiv velaachoto habbetula hakkerova elav asher lo hayta leish. delav chulakeh deesav, vela havavt beadveh dehahu dichtiv beh (Bereshit 25:27) ish yodea tzayid ish sade, lah yittamma, beinnun levushin denukema, dezammin leistaava ben innun uchelusin, dichtiv beh lah yittamma, beginah, begin deihi shechivat leafra, vehu bae leakkama lah, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:1) kumi ori ki va orech. (sefer acher 2 beyom hahu akim et sukkat david hannofelet).

(Vayikra 21:5) lo yikrechu karcha berosham. ribbi yose amar, lo yikrechu beHei may taama. ella, hahu shemen illaa, deihu meshach revut kudesha, deashlim lechol shiva yomin kema deittemar, dichtiv, (Vayikra 8:33) ki shivat yamim yemalle et yedchem, hahu shemen illaa itade minneh veitkerach, i ihu afgim resheh. begin deresha dechahana illaa, hahu shemen illaa havi, veal da la live leh lechahana diltatta, leachazaa beh begarmeh pegimu kelal, veha ittemar. uvegin kach ketiv beHei.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 126:1) beshuv Adonai et shivat tziyyon hayinu kecholmim. beshuv Adonai et shivat, da begalut bavel ittemar. dela ishtechachu yatir begaluta ella shivin shenin. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 29:10) ki lefi melot levavel shivim shana efkod etchem. uchetiv hayinu kecholmim, may kecholmim. ella ha ataru chavrayyay, deikka shivin
1211: Veta chaze, ketiv ki shivat yamim yemalle et yedchem. man shivat yamim. ha ittemar, hahu atar illaa, dehu kelala dechol shita ochoranin, ikre shivat yamim, veikre teshuva. tanenan, man deyativ betaanita beshabbeta, korin lo gezar dino shel shivim shana, veshivin shana innun sheva anpe malka, deafillu istechamu aleh (kolla) levish, hahu gezar dina itkera. may tama. begin deachid beh behahu yoma, bichlala dechullehu, deikre shiva, veikre teshuva, begin kach bechullehu achid, veahdar bitshuva, veitkera gezar dina bechullehu. veal da vadday shivin shenin ikka bechelma.

Kegavvna da, kahana itattar besheva, deikre shivat yamim, i pagim resheh, hahu shiva deihu kelala dechullehu, akrach minneh kol hahu kedushsha dechullehu, desharya aleh. veal da izdeharu dela yikrechu karcha berosham, veyishtechachu pegimin mikkolla. uvegin kach kahana bae leishtakkecha bishlimu yattir mikkolla, kol shekken hahu deihu illaa mekullehu.

Amar ribbi abba, kan beHei tattaa, kan beHei illaa. kohen gadol deihu illaa mekullehu, beHei illaa. dichtiv asher yutzak al rosho shemen hammishcha umille et yado vegomer. umille yado dichtiv shivat yamim yemalle et yedchem. kahana ochora baAdonai tattaa, dichtiv, lo yikrechu karcha berosham, uchetiv batreh, velo yechallelu shem elohehem. vehay shem ha yedia ihu. uvegin kach ketiv, vehakkohen haggadol meechav asher yutzak al rosho shemen hammishcha lilbosh et habbegadim, kema deamaran. uvegin deihu kaddisha kegavvna dilella, ketiv umin hammikdash lo yetze.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Daniel 9:7) lecha Adonai hatztzedaka velanu boshet happanim kehayyom hazze leish yehuda uleyoshve yerushala 40. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, mikkol ammin ovde avoda zara, umiggo rechimuta dilhon, yahav lehu orayyta dikshot, leminda archa demalka kaddisha. vechol man deishtedal beorayyta, keillu ishtaddal beh bekudesha berich hu, deorayyta kolla shemeh dekudesha berich hu havi. uvegin kach man deitassak beorayyta, itassak beh bishmeh, uman deitrechak meorayyta, rechika hu mekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, lecha Adonai hatztzedaka, kema deat amer, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai haggedulla vehagevura. man tzedaka. atar dechol anpin nehirin achidan beh, vehu achid bechullehu, uveh ishtechachu. velanu boshet happanim atar dechol anpin nehirin itrachakan minneh. tzedaka, emet keshot, unehora decholla, unehora deanpin chedu decholla. boshet, kissufa rechiku dikshot man deachsif, begin deemet deihu tzedaka, itrechak minneh. rechiku deanpin nehirin.

Ta chaze, kahana illaa bae leitchazaa bishpiru deanpin, binhiru deanpin, bechedu yattir mikkolla. vela bae leitchazaa beh atzivu verugeza, ella kolla kegavvna dilella. zakkaa chulakeh, dealeh ketiv, (Bamidbar 18:20) ani chelkecha venachalatcha. uchetiv (Devarim 18) Adonai hu nachalato. veal da bae leitchazaa shelim becholla, begarmeh, bilvusheh, dela yafgim garmeh kelal, kema deittemar. (hay ihu batar nayshaveayn vechulei, ad leara deyisrael daf 276 amud alef shita 4. zehu ketzat maamar mareaya mehemana matzati behetek vanedapes beorech befarashat ki tetze ki sham beto maamar matchil veanshu oto)

(Vayikra 21:13) vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach. ribbi shimon patach, (Devarim 22:17) vehinne hu sam alilot devarim vegomer. uchetiv veanshu oto mea chesef vegomer, ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael, vechi betulat yisrael hi, betulat aviha, o betulat balah hi, mahu

Raya mehemna ki im betula meammav yikkach ishsha, patach raya mehemana veamar, pikkuda da, lemesav kahana rabba betuleta, hada hu dichtiv almana ugerusha vachalala zona et elle lo yikkach ki im betula meammav yikkach ishsha. vaamay baenan dela yissav ella betuleta bela pegimu. ella, itteta ihi kos divracha, taamu pegamo. vechahana dekariv karbena kodam Adonai, bae delihevi ihu shelim, bela pegimu, shelim beevaroy bela pegimu, demumin paslin bechahanaya. shelim begufeh, shelim benukeveh, lekayyeyma beh, (Shir HaShirim 4:7) kullach yafa rayati umum en bach.

Dekarbena mincha ihu, utztzerichin yisrael lemishlach minchata dilhon lemalka, bigvar (beguf) shelim. deinnun behippucha desitra ochora, deha beyad ish itti pagim, havo shalchin leh dorona, dichtiv (Vayikra 16:8) goral echad laAdonai vegoral echad laazazil. deelohim acherim kullehu pegimin missitra detztzafon vehachi rubba devate avoda zara hem pegimin, benukeba dilhon, chureva, lilit, pegimuta vechulei.

(Sefer acher veraaya mehemana) ihu 6 malle veihu besidura da Yahu. Adonai batraa, kos malle birkat Adonai, missitra dimina umissitra digvura deihu dina, shechinta itkeriat 26, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 9:3) hinne yad Adonai hoya bemiknecha asher bassade. kam raya mehemna, veishtetach kammeh. veamar zakkaa chulaki dematronita demare (umatronita) inhu beezri. 1212: Betulat yisrael hacha. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:7) sheal avicha veyagedcha zekenecha veyomru lach. uf hacha kahana dekaim kegavvna dilella, ketiv vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach, hachi name vivtuleha, dela tifuk mibbava dechatzerah mizzimna levar, veha ittemar.

Ribbi shimon hava azil bearcha, vahavu immeh ribbi yehuda vribbi yose vribbi chizkiyya. patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 111:5) teref natan lireav yizkor leolam berito. teref natan lireav, illen innun zakkain, innun dachale dekudesha berich hu, dechol man dedachil leh, itkere meinshe deveta demalka, vealeh ketiv, (Tehillim 112:1) ashre ish yare et Adonai.

Mahu teref natan lireav. ella kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah. mehacha olifna, dechol bar nash delae beorayyta belelya, vekam befalgut lelya, beshaata dichneset yisrael itarat leatkena beta lemalka, hay ishtetaf bahadah, vehay ikre mibbe malka, veyahavin leh kol yoma meinnun tikune beta, hada hu dichtiv vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. man beta. kol inun demishtatfe bahada belelya, ikrun betah, bene betah. uvegin kach teref natan lireav.

Mahu teref. teref mamash, deihi natla meatar rechika illaa, dichtiv (Mishlei 31:14) mimmerchak tavi lachmah. uman zache lehay teref, sofeh dikra ochach, dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:9) yizkor leolam berito. man deistakkal (sefer acher deishtaddal) beorayyta, leishtattefa bahadah belelya. vela od, ella detzaddik chad illaa it leh lekudesha berich hu, vehu ishtetaf bahadeh, veyartin tarvavyyhu lichnishta deyisrael, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz.

Tu patach veamar, (Vayikra 21:15) velo yechallel zaro beammav ki ani Adonai mekaddesho. ta chaze, kol man deappik zera levattala, la zache lemechome appe shechinta, veikre ra, dichtiv (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra. hay man deappik leh bideh, o beintu ochora dela kashra. vei tema deappik leh beintu dela mitabbera, hachi name. la. ella kema deamaran.

Veal da yive bar nash mikudesha berich hu, deyazmin leh mana dechashra, dela yafgim zareh, man deappik zara bemana dela kashra, pagim leh lezareh, vavy leman defagim zareh. uma bishar bene nasha kach, bechahana dekaim letatta kegavvna dilella bikdushsha illaa, al achat kama vechamma.

Beammav, mahu beammav. deha ketiv leella, almana ugerusha vachalala zona et elle lo yikkach, uchetiv velo yechallel zaro beammav. bahem mibbae leh, mahu beammav. ella milla da kelana beammav, pegimu beammav, veal da ketiv, ki im betula meammav yikkach ishsha, meamav vaday, kolla kegavvna dilella, ki ani Adonai mekaddesho, mahu mekaddesho. ella ana hu hahu, deihu mekaddesh leh bechol yoma, uvegin kach la yafgim zareh, vela yishtechach beh pegimu. (sefer acher uvegin da) deha ani Adonai mekaddesho daana baena lekaddesha leh veyishtechach kaddisha becholla, dekaddisha yishtammesh al yeda dekaddisha.
1213: Yishtammesh al yede dechahana, veyishtechach kaddisha kad ate leshammesha, uvegin dekudesha berich hu yishtammesh al yeda dechahana deihu kaddisha, kahana yishtammesh al yede dedachya, deitkkaddash bedachyuteh, umay ihu. levae. bar nash (kahana) ochora, yishtammesh al yede dekaddisha ochora, begin deyishtachchun kolla bikdushsha, leshammesha lekudesha berich hu. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den uvealma deate, dealayyhu ketiv, (Vayikra 20:26) vaavdil etchem min haammim lihyot li. kama perishan yisrael mikkolla, bikdushsha, leshammeshsha lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 20:7) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki ani Adonai elohechem.

Tu patach veamar, (Tehillim 3:9) laAdonai hayeshua al ammecha virchatecha sela. laAdonai hayeshua. hachi tanenan, zakkain innun yisrael, divchol atar deitgalu, shechinta itgalyay bahadayyhu. kad yippekun yisrael miggaluta, purekana leman, leyisrael o lekudesha berich hu. ella ha ukemuha bechamma kerae, vehacha, laAdonai hayeshua vadday, ematay. al ammecha virchatecha sela. beshaata dekudesha berich hu yashgach bevirchan alayyhu deyisrael, leappaka lon min galuta, uleotava lehu, keden laAdonai hayeshua vadday. veal da tanenan, dekudesha berich hu yetuv immehon deyisrael min galuta, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha verichamecha.

(Vayikra 21:17) ish mizzaracha ledorotam asher yihye bo mum. ribbi yitzchak amar, begin deihu pagim, uman deihu pagim, la itchaze leshammesha bekudesha. veha ukemuha, debar nash deishtechach pagim, let beh mehemnuta, vehahu pegimu ashid aleh, kol shekken kahana, devaya leishtachcha shelim, mareh dimhemnuta, yatir micholla, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi elazar hava yativ bekistera deve chamuy, vehu hava amar, zilga divkistira beeta shechiach. adhachi, avar chad bar nash, pagim meeneh chad. amar chamuy, nishal lehay. amar, pagim hu, velav mehemana. amar, nishal bahadeh. atu sheilu leh. amar leh, tufeka man hu bealma. amar atira, aval deyashlif, bahadeh ana mikkullehu. (sefer acher attira, aval deyashlif, vavy al da, bahadeh ana mikkullehu) amar ribbi elazar, bemilloy ishtema, delav mehemnuta gabbeh, velav bar mehemana hu. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu amar chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav, deha kedushsha dilella, la sharya baatar pagim.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 8:20) letora velituda im lo yomru kaddavar hazze. letora velituda. man hu tora, uman hu teuda. ella tora, da tora shebbichtav. teuda, da tora shebbeal pe. tora shebbeal pe la sharya baatar pagim, deha mittora shebbichtav itbene. ketiv tzor teuda chatom tora belimmuday, tzor teuda, da tora shebbeal pe, begin detamman ittetzar tzerora dechayye, uvituda itkeshar kishra dechayye (nusach acher kishra dimhemnuta) dilella, lemehevi kolla chad.
Umittamman letatta itparshan orchin ushevilin, umittamman mitparshin orchin bealmin kullehu hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim.

Chatom tora, chatima deorayyta, deihi tora shebbichtav bean atar. belimmuday, illen nevie, kema deat amer (Melachim 1 7:21) vayyakem et haammud hayemani vayyikra shemo yachin vayakem et haammud hassemali vayikra shemo boaz. umittamman itparshan orchin linvie mehemne, vekayyme illen bekiyyuma legufa, leshit tehirin, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:15) shokav ammude shesh. vecholla la kayyeyma ella bishlimu, vela sharya kedushsha decholla, ella bishlimu, kad mitchabberan da beda, kolla hu shelim, kolla hu chad, la itpegim atar. veal da ikre keneset yisrael shalem, kema deat amer (Bereshit 14:18) umalki tzedek melech shalem (Tehillim 76:3) vayhi veshalem sukko.

Uvegin kach la sharya kolla, ella baatar shelim. veal da chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav. kegavvna da karbena deveh muma la yitkeriv. may tama. dichtiv ki lo leratzon yihye lachem. vei tema ha kudesha berich hu la share ella baatar tevira, bemana tevira, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach. hay atar shelim yattir hu mikkolla, (dichtiv, 1 veet dakka ushefal ruach) begin demaich garmeh lemishre aleh gauta decholla, gauta illaa, veda hu shelim. aval la ketiv, vet
1214: Ivvir veshavur vecharum vesarua. ella veet dakka ushefal ruach, man demaich garmeh, kudesha berich hu zakif leh.
Uvegine kach, kahana dekaim letatta kegavvna dilella, bae lemehevi shelim yattir mikkolla, vela yitchaze pagim, veal da azhar lehu lechahane, dichtiv ish mizzaracha ledorotam asher yihye vo mum.

Tu patach veamar, (Malachi 1:8) vechi taggishun ivvir lizboach en ra, vechi taggishu fisseach vechole en ra, vechi kudesha berich hu amar en ra, i hachi tov hu. ella sofeh dikra ochach, deyisrael beinnun yomin havo memanan kahane mare demumin, al gabbe madbecha, uleshammesha al makdesha, veamre may ichpat leh lekudesha berich hu da, o ochora. veinnun havo deamre en ra. vekudesha berich hu ativ lehon hahi milla dahavo amre. amar: yisrael attun amre kad mekarve mare demumin al pulechani en ra, may ichpat leh lekudesha berich hu.

Sofeh dikra ma ketiv, hakerivehu na lefechatcha hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha. bar nash minnayychu, i baitu leshalume lemalka, ulekarva kammeh dorona, attun meshadrin leh bifgima, o la. hayirtzecha o hayissa fanecha behahu dorona, kol shekken vekol shekken deattun mekarvin kamay bar nash pagim lekarva dorona, ha dorona dilchon lechalba itmesar, devadday bar nash deihu pagim, pagim hu mikkolla, pagim hu mehemnuta. veal da chol ish asher bo mum lo yikrav.

Amar ribbi yose, zammin kudesha berich hu leashlema lehu leyisrael, uleishtakkecha shelemin becholla, dela yehe behon mare demumin kelal, begin dihon tikkuna dealma, keillen mane ulevusha debar nash deinnun tikkuna degufa, hada hu dichtiv (Iyov 38:14) vyityatztzevu kemo levush.

(Sefer acher davar acher) ta chaze, kad yittearun meafra, kema dealu, hachi yekumun, chigrin o sumin. alu chigrin vesumin, yekumun behahu levusha, dela yemrun deochora hu deittear. ulevatar, kudesha berich hu yese lon, veyishtachchun shelemin kammeh, ucheden yehe alma shelim becholla, keden (Zecharya 14:9) bayom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

(Vayikra 22:27) shor o chesev o ez ki yivvaled vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 36:7) tzidkatcha keharere el mishpatecha tehom rabba adam uvehema toshia Adonai. hay kera it leistakkela beh, aval ta chaze, tzedek: kitra kadisha illaa. keharere el: keinnun turin illain kaddishin, deikrun ture deafarsemona dachya. uvegin deihi salleka leitkashshera behu leella, kol dinaha beshshikula chada lecholla, delet behahu dina rachame. mishpatecha tehom rabba. mishpat deihu rachame, nachit letatta lehahu darga letakkena almin, vechayes al kolla, veavid dina berachame levassema alma.

Uvegin deihu rachame, adam uvehema toshia Adonai. lecholla beshshikula chada. adam uvehema, ha ukemuha, man dehu adam, veshavvi legarmeh kabbehema. adam uvehema: din adam, vedin behema, chad hu. adam: (Bereshit 17:12) uven shemonat yamim yimmol lachem kol zachar. behema: vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo umiom hashshemini vahala yeratze lekarban ishshe laAdonai, begin diavar alayyhu shabbat chad, veha (hakedama 13) ukemuha.

Ribbi chiyyay patach (Shoftim Adonai:4) Adonai betzetcha misseir betzadecha missede edom eretz raasha gam shamayim natafu. ta chaze, zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate, dekudesha berich hu itree behu, veinnun mitdabbekin beh, veikrun kaddishin, am kadosh. vechen ad desalik lon ledarga illaa deikre kodesh, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato. kema deokimna, deha yisrael mittemanya yomin mitdabbekin beh bishmeh, ureshimin bishmeh, veinnun dileh. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz. veammin la mitdabbekin beh, vela azlin benimmuseh, ureshima kaddisha adiu minnayyhu, ad
1215: Deinnun mitdabbekan besitra ochora delav kaddisha.

Veta chaze, beshaata devaa kudesha berich hu lemehav orayyta leyisrael, zammin bah livne esav, amar lon, baan attun lekabbela orayyta. behahi shaata itregizat ara kaddisha, uvaat leaala lenukeba dithoma rabba. amra kammeh, mare dealma, pastira dechedva (sefer acher dealma) tere alfe shenin ad la itbere alma, kaltina kammeh (nusach acher kaleytenaa go) (nusach acher izdaman kamme) arelin dela reshiman bekiyyumach.

Amar lah kudesha berich hu, kuresyay kuresyay, yevdun elef umin kevavtayyhu, vekayyayma deorayyta la yizdeman kammayyhu, hada hu dichtiv Adonai betzetcha misseir betzadecha missede edom eretz raasha. vadday begin deorayyta la ityeyhivat (begin deihu kayyeyma kaddisha) ella leman deit beh kayyayma kaddisha. uman deyalif orayyta leman dela itgezar, meshakker bitre kayyme, meshakker bekayayma deorayyta, umeshakker bekayayma detzaddik ucheneset yisrael. deorayyta lehay atar ityeyhivat, vela leochora.

Ribbi abba amar, meshakker bitlat duchete illae, meshakker battora, meshakker banneviim, meshakker bakketuvim. meshakker battora, dichtiv, (Devarim 4) vezot hattora vegomer. meshakker banviim dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:13) vechol banayich limmude Adonai. innun limmude Adonai, vela ochora, uchetiv (Yeshayahu 8:16) chatom tora belimmuday, innun, vela ochora. meshakker bakketuvim, dichtiv, (Tehillim 78:5) vayyakem edut beyaakov vetora sam beyisrael, uchetiv (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha. man tzaddikim. da tzaddik ucheneset yisrael. deman dela itgezar, vela al bekiyyuma dilhon, la yodun lishmeh kaddisha, dehi orayyta. amar ribbi chiyyay kevan deitgele kudesha berich hu al tura desinay, lemehav orayyta leyisrael, shechivat ara, vetavat benayycha, hada hu dichtiv, (sham 76) eretz yara veshakata.

Ta chaze, bar nash deityeylid la itmana aleh chela dilella, ad deitgezar. kevan deitgezar, ittear aleh (rucha) ittearuta derucha dilella. zache leitasseka beorayyta, ittear aleh ittearuta yattir. zache veavid pikkude orayyta, ittear aleh ittearuta yattir. zache veitnesiv, zache veolid benin, veolif lon orchoy demalka kaddisha, ha keden hu adam shelim. shelim becholla.

Aval behema deityelidat, behahi shaata deityelidat, hahu chela deit lah besofah, it lah behahi shaata deityelidat, veitmana aleh. uvegin kach ketiv, shor o chesev o ez ki yivvaled. egel o tale, o sair o gedi la ittemar, ella shor o chesev o ez, hahu deit leh lesofa, it leh beshaata deityeylid.

Vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo, begin leityashsheva beh hahu chela veitkayyaym beh. uvemma yitkayyaym beh. kad yishre aleh shabbat chad, vei la, la yitkeyyaym. (veod daatayybesh mazevahemaa deimmeh) ulevatar deyitkeyyaym beh hahu chela, ketiv yeratze lekarban ishshe laAdonai, bekiyyuma deshabbat chad, deabar aleh.

Uvar nash, bekiyyuma deshabbat chad, itkayyaym beh ittearuta dehay alma, vechela dileh. batar deitgezar, ittear aleh ittearuta derucha illaa, ukkeneset yisrael abar aleh, vechamat leh, birshima kaddisha, veatarat aleh, vesharya aleh rucha dehahu alma kaddisha, kema deat amer, (Yechezkel 16:6) vaeevor alayich vaerech mitboseset bedamayich vegomer. bedamayich: bitre.

Vei tema, hatam kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, dishchiach benayyhu dam pesach vedam mila, keden ketiv bedamayich chayi, hacha may bedamayich. ella teren, chad demila, vechad difria. chad digziru, dichneset yisrael. vechad difria, betzaddik yesod olam. veillen teren damin devar nash kaim beginayyhu bekiyyuma dealma deate, hada hu dichtiv bedamayich chayi.
Ribbi shimon amar, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam. sod Adonai lireav, da keneset yisrael. uverito lehodiam, da tzaddik yesod olam,
1216: Yod, telat atvavn, shelemuta decholla. 10 reshita decholla. 10 illaa decholla. vav emtzaita, shelemuta dechol sitrin. mabar lechol ruchin, beh talya mehemnuta. dalet, ginta, tzerora dechayye. at da zeera, shelema decholla.
