(vav hei 6 ben besitra da, ben besitra achara, shelimu hu decholla. 11) hu shelimu yattir, leattera lecholla ha decholla chad, veha attearu beh chavrayyay.

Ta chaze, vehaya shivat yamim vegomer. yod hei vav hei (nusach acher vav hei yod hei) itgelifu atvavn (vehaya). 6 Adonai, ha shivat yomin itkelilu bechad. 10 Adonai, shivat yomin. 10 chad, kelala decholla. Adonai telat, hi uteren benin. uvera chad, teren avahan beh kelilan, ha shita (chamsha). beratta nukeba chad, ha shiva (shita), ishtema de illaa kelala deshita. 15 ha shiva. hayeynu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 8:65) shivat yamim veshivat yamim arbaa asar yom.

Vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo. tachat immo, itattaru shivat yamim, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) lecha Adonai haggedulla vehaggevura vegomer. veal da shivat yamim letatta, likara deimma illaa. tachat immo letatta. dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:Adonai) ad akara yalda shiva verabbat banim umlala. ikkara dechol beta, yalda shiva, illen shivat yomin dechag hassukkot. verabbat banim umlala, illen karbenin dechag, denachtin bechol yoma min minyayna.

Veta chaze illen sallekin leella leella, veillen nachtin letatta letatta, kema deat amer (Ovadya 1:4) im tagbiah kannesher veim ben kochavim sim kinnecha mishsham oridcha neum Adonai. veyisrael sallekin mittatta leella, dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:14) vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz, uchetiv (Bereshit 26:4) vehirbeti et zaracha kechochve hashshamayim, ulevatar sallekin al kolla, umitdabbekan baatar illaa al kolla, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem vegomer.

(Vayikra 22:28) veshor o se oto veet beno. amar ribbi yose, ketargumo lah velivrah. deikara deimma leminda berah, veazil batrah, vela azil batar avuha, vaanan la yadenan man hu. lo tishchatu beyom echad.

Amar ribbi yehuda, may tama. i tema mishshum agmat nefesh divira, nechus lehay beveta chad, ulehay beveta ochora. o lehay hasheta, ulehay levatar. amar leh, it man deshare, velav hache, ella beyom echad mammash.

Ta chaze tanenan yafa taanit lachalom, keesh lanneoret. veikkara detaanita behahu yoma mammash, velav beyoma ochora. may taama. begin delet lecha yom letatta, dela shalta beh yoma ochora illaa. vechad ihu share betaanita dechelma, olifna dehahu yoma la itade, ad deitbetal hahu gezera. vei dache leh leyoma ochora, ha shuletana deyoma ochora hu, vela al yoma beyoma ochora dechavreh. kehay gavvna, let lach yom dela itmana aleh yoma illaa leella. uvae bar nash leistammera, dela yabid pegimu behahu yoma, vela yitpegim kamme shear yomin ochoranin.
Vetanenan, beovada diltatta ittear ovada dilella. i bar nash avid ovada letatta kidka
1217: Yeot, hachi ittear chela kidka yeot leella, avid bar nash chesed bealma, ittear chesed leella, veshari behahu yoma, veitattar beh begineh. vei itdabber bar nash lerachame letatta, ittear rachame al hahu yoma, veitattar berachame begineh. ucheden hahu yoma kaim aleh lemehevi appotroppa begineh, beshaata deitzterich leh.

Kegavvna da, behippucha deda. (veal kolla) i avid bar nash ovada deachzari, hachi ittear behahu yoma, ufagim leh, ulevatar kaim aleh leachzari leshetzaa leh mealma. behahi midda devar nash moded, bah moddin leh.

Tenan, deyisrael achzariut itmenna minnayyhu, mikkol shear ammin, vela yitchazun minneh ovada bealma. deha kamma mare deayynin kayymin aleh devar nash behahu ovada, zakkaa man deachze ovada dechashra letatta, deha beovada talyay milleta becholla, leitteara milla ochora.
Ribbi shimon patach, (Bereshit 42:1) vayar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim, hay kera raza dechachmeta it beh, veit lan leistakkela beh, delav sefeh resheh, velav resheh sefeh.

Ella ta chaze, beshaata dekudesha berich hu bae lemedan alma bechafna, la yahiv milla da leyada decharoza, deha kol dinin ochoranin dealma, karoza kariz alohi ad la yetun lealma, vedina da la ityeyhiv lecharoza, ella kudesha berich hu achriz aleh vekari. hada hu dichtiv, (Melachim 2 8) ki kara Adonai laraev. mehahi shaata itpakkedan al alma memanan ochoranin, bifkidu deraav. (dateraayn).

Veasir leh levar nash deit leh sava, leachazaa begarmeh sava, deha achze pegimu leella, veachchish milla demalka, vechivyachol keillu abar memanan demalka meatrayyhu. veal da amar yaakov livnoy, lamma titrau, lama taavidu pegimu leella uletatta, uleachchasha milla demalka, vechol innun memanan bichrizu dileh.

Aval hinne shamati ki yesh shever bemitzrayim redu shamma, vetamman achziu garmayychu besava, vela tachchishu pamalya dilella hacha. veta chaze, yaakov kama tevua havat leh, vela bae lishbor ella betoch habbaim begin dela yishtekach pegimu beovada dileh.
Tu patach veamar, (Vayikra 9:22) vayissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarachem. vetanenan yado ketiv, devae lezakfa yemina al semala. vaamay. leachazaa ovada letatta, begin deyittear ovada leella.

Ketiv (Vayikra 25:9) vehaavarta shofar terua bachodesh hashshevii vegomer, shofar terua amay. ella shofar, dematbar shalshelain, dematbar shuletanuta mikkol avdin. uvaya leachazaa shofar deihu pashit, vela kafif, leachazaa cheru lecholla, deha yoma garim. uvecholla bae leachazaa ovada, veal da shofar, vela keren, begin leachazaa man hu atar deikre shofar.

Zakkain innun yisrael bealma den uvealma deate, deinnun yadin leitdabbeka bemalka kaddisha, uleatara chela dilella, uleamshacha kedushsha demarehon alayyhu, begin kach ketiv (Devarim 33:29) ashrecha yisrael mi chamocha vegomer. (Devarim 4:4) veatem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

Hakedamat raya mehemna (Vayikra 22:31) ushemartem mitztzevotay vaasitem otam vegomer. pikudin demare alma, ha tanenan. dichtiv ushemartem mitztzevotay vaasitem otam. i neture ka baenan, ayvida lamma. tu, kol pikkude orayyta innun bitren gavvnin deinnun chad, zachor veshamor, zachor lidchura, veshamor lenukeba. vechullehu kelala chada, i shamor lenukeba amay ketiv ushemartem (et kol) mitztzevotay.

Ella kolla behay kera, ushemartem: da shamor. vaasitem: da zachor, decholla raza chada. zechira da ihi asiyya, deha man deadkar milla letatta, atkin (avidu mittamman lehahu raza dilella, vechol man deavid milla letatta) veitavid hahu raza dilella. pikkude orayyta illen innun shit mea utelesar pikudin, deinnun kelala didchar venukeba, vecholla raza chada.
1218: (Shemot 25 amud alef ulekachtem) (Vayikra 22:32) velo techallelu et shem kadshi venikdashti betoch bene yisrael vegomer. pikkuda da, lekaddesha leh bechol yoma, lesalleka kedushateh mittatta leella, kema deihu kaddisha leella, ad desalik kedushateh laavahan uvenin. veraza da, venikdashti betoch bene yisrael, ella vetatta. ella beg dargin. letatta beg dargin.

Kedushsha, ha okimna bechamma duchete, aval kema deit kedusha leella al kolla, hachi it kedushsha beemtztzaita, kedushsha letatta. vecholla beraza diltatta (sefer acher bitlata), kedushsha dilella leella, beraza chada. kedushsha beemtztzaita uletatta telat dargin deinnun chad.

Kadosh, ihu setar illaa, deishtechach reshita lechol dargin. veaf al gav deihu setar temira, veikre kodesh. mittamman itpeshat peshitu, denahir bechad shevila dekika temira, go emtztzaita. kevan deitnehir go emtztzaita, keden itreshim chad 6, denahir go hay kodesh, veikre kadosh. mehay nehiru itpeshat peshitu letatta, sofa dechol dargin. kevan deitnehir besofa, keden itreshim binhiru, chad Adonai, veikre kedushsha, veha okimna.

Uma deikre kadosh kadosh kadosh, deha kodesh mibbae leh, raza dereshita (sefer acher deihu reshita) decholla, hoil umittamman ishtechach, vei hachi amay ikre leella kadosh, deha tamman 6 la ishtechach.

Ella raza hachi hu vday, veyisrael mekaddeshe letatta, kegavvna demalache illae leella, dichtiv behu, (Yeshayahu 6:3) vekara ze el ze veamar kadosh. vechevan deyisrael ka mekaddeshe, salke mittatta leella yekara illaa, ad deistellak 6 raza deshamayim illain leella. kevan deinnun shamayim istelaku leella, nahir hahu kodesh behu, ucheden ikre leella kadosh. ulevatar nahir hahu nehiru illaa, al kuresyay deihu shamayim. veinnun shamayim tayyvin leduchetayyhu, umityayshshevu beh behahu nehiru, ucheden ikre kadosh. levatar nachit hahu nehiru, ad denatil kolla chad tzaddik illaa, darga yakkira lekaddesha kolla letatta. kevan deihu natil kolla, keden ikre kadosh. veda ihu raza decholla.

Veman deshavvi reuteh behay, shappir ka avid. uman deshavvi reuteh, bitlat dargin daavahan bichlala chada, leyachada lon go kedushata da, i la yachil leshavvava reuteh yattir, shappir ka avid. vecholla lenachta miggo kedushshata dilella letatta, lekaddesha kol chad garmeh behay kedushsha, ulenatra leh, lemifras perisu dikdushshata al gabbeh. veraza da, venikdashti betoch bene yisrael bekadmita, ulevatar ani Adonai mekaddishchem.

Bean atar yekaddesh bar nash garmeh go kedushata da, leachlela garmeh bah. kad mate bar nash, lishma kaddisha Adonai tzevaot. veraza da ani Adonai mekaddishchem. da ashkachna beraza desifre kadmae. vaanan la avdenan hache, ella levatar Adonai tzevaot bilchodoy. ulevatar kad mate bar nash limlo chol haaretz kevodo, keden yichlol garmeh behahu kedushsha, leitkaddesha letatta, go hahu kavod diltatta, veraza da venikdash bichvodi. (Shemot 50 amud alef, 207 amud alef, nasha 143 amud bet) ulevatar yavid orach perat, leitkaddesha kolla. kema daanan avdin leummatam demalache illae, deamre baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo, da kavod illaa. ulevatar yimloch Adonai leolam vechulei. da kavod diltatta.

Uvesifra derav yisa sava, kadosh kadosh kadosh vechulei, da ihi kedushsha leitkaddesha tora shebbichtav bichlala chada. ulevatar leummatam baruch kevod Adonai, illen neviim. ulevatar yimloch Adonai leolam. raza da, anan tzerichin bikdushshata da, leishtakkecha tamman kedushsha uveracha umalchut, leishtakkecha kolla kachada. kedushsha, kema deittemar kadosh. beracha, baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. malchut, yimloch Adonai leolam. veal da kolla anan tzerichin leashlema, veal da yechavvivn bar nash, vishavvi reuteh bechol yoma. (ad kan raya mehemana)

(Vayikra 23:10) dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem elle moade Adonai asher tikreu otam mikrae kodesh elle hem moaday. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayikra elohim laor yom vegomer. tanenan, or dehava bekadmita, hava nahir missayyfe alma lesayyfe alma, kad istakkal kudesha berich hu lechayayvin dizminin lemekam bealma, ganiz leh letzaddikayyay lealma deate, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:15) veyimmana mershaim oram. uchetiv (Tehillim 97:11) or zarua latztzaddik.

Ta chaze, vayikra elohim laor yom velachoshech kara layla, ha tanenan, yehi or, or dichvar hava. vehacha, i tema or deihu yom bilchodoy, hadar veamar velachoshech kara layla. i tema kol chad bilchodoy,
1219: Hadar veamar vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad. delayla let bela yom, velet yom bela layla, vela ikre echad, ella beziuuga chad, vekudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael ikre echad, veda bela da la ikre echad.

Ta chaze, begin dichneset yisrael hasheta begaluta, kivyachol la ikre echad. veematay ikre echad. beshaata deyippekun yisrael min galuta, ucheneset yisrael ahadrat leatraha, leizdavvevga beh bekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. (begin kach vayhi erev vayhi bakar yom echad) veda bela da la ikre echad.

Ta chaze, moade Adonai asher tikreu vegomer. lezammena kolla laatar chad, uleishtakkecha kolla bishlimu, beraza deechad. ulemehevi yisrael (beziuuga chada) letatta goy echad baaretz. tinach kudesha berich hu bichneset yisrael deikre echad, yisrael letatta deinnun zeminin kegavvna dilella, bema yikrun echad.

Ella, biyrushala 40 diltatta, yikrun yisrael echad. mena lan. dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 7:23) goy echad baaretz. vadday, baaretz hem goy echad, immah ikrun echad, vela innun bilchodayyhu. deha umi cheammecha yisrael goy echad sagge leh, aval la ikrun echad, ella baaretz, beziuuga dehay eretz kegavvna dilela. uvegin kach, kola kashir da beda bezivuga chada, zakkaa chulekehon deyisrael. sheshet yamim tease melacha ittemar, veha ukemuha.

(Rabbi yose verabbi chiyyay azle bearcha vechulei. ad hoshia yemincha vaaneni. 0 amar leh et chame vaana chamena mippumeh derabbi shimon shemana milla uvachena. amar leh may hay veachar millat da deitgezar bi kedka yeot).

(Vayikra 23:4) elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh asher tikreu otam bemoadam. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 27:8) lecha amar libbi bakkeshu fanay et panecha Adonai avakkesh. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay bechamma atar, aval hay kera hachi ittemar, lecha amar libbi, david malka amar da begin keneset yisrael, lokovel malka kaddisha. umay amar. lecha amar libbi, beginach amar libbi livne alma, veazhar lon libbi. deihu achid beh, deda begin malka illaa amar. bakkeshu fanay, illen itre malka, deihu achid behu, veinnun beh. innun shemeh, veihu ushemeh, milla chada hu. begin kach amar david et panecha Adonai avakkesh, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 105:4) dirshu Adonai veuzzo bakkeshu fanav tamid.
Ta chaze, yaut hu david malka lememar shirata begin keneset yisrael, yattir mikkol bene alma, ulememar mille dichneset yisrael lemalka, begin deihu achid bah.

Davar acher lecha amar libbi bakkeshu fanay. beginach amar libbi livne alma, bakkeshu (sefer acher et panecha Adonai avakkesh) fanay illen zimnayyay vechagayay dechullehu zammin lehon laatar deikre kodesh, begin leatra lon, kol chad vechad beyomeh, kol chad vechad bizmaneh, veyishavun kullehu mehahu amika daamikta, denachalin umabbuin nafkin minneh, begin kach ketiv mikrae kodesh, zeminin innun lehahu atar deikre kodesh, leitattera beh, uleishtaava beh, begin deyitkaddeshun kulhon kachada, veyishtechach behu chedvavta.

Ribbi abba amar, mikrae kodesh: zeminin dekodesh. vechad mehay zeminin, zeminin min nachala denaggid venafik. lemalka dezammin bene nasha lisudateh, attar kamayyhu mikkol zine mechla dealma, aftach lehu garbe chamra, shappir berecha, shappir lemishteyay. dehachi itchaze, man dimzammin lemechla ulemishteyay zammin. kach mikrae kodesh, kevan deinnun zeminin lisudata demalka, zeminin innun lechamra tav veshappir demintera. (kema deat amar 0 ki tovim dodecha mayin) veal da mikrae kodesh ketiv.

Asher tikreu otam bemoadam, ketiv (Shemot 22:30) veanshe kodesh tihyun li, yisrael letatta ikrun anshe kodesh. kevan dizminin innun mikkodesh dilella attun anshe kodesh letatta zemina lehu, keden atkinu seudata, vechadu, deha lechu itchaze, begin deattun itkerun anshe kodesh, veyehon kullehu
1220: Zeminin bechol sitrin dekodesh leella vetatta.

Davar acher (Vayikra 23:4) elle moade Adonai. mahu moade Adonai. rabbi shimon amar, meAdonai innun. deveh itkashsharu mitatta leella, umeella letatta, kullehu beh mitkashsheran, umitatteran (sefer acher vametaataden) (nusach acher umitachadan) kullehu, leitkashshera kishra chad bekishra demalka. may taama. kema demalka yarit leabba uleimma, veachid behahu kodesh, veitattar behu. (begin) kach kol innun daachidan beh bemalka, bayayn leizdammena behahu atar illaa deikre kodesh, begin deyitachadu kullehu kachada (lemalka). veal da moade Adonai ikre, ulevatar mikrae kodesh, deha behu itattar bemalka.

Asher tikreu otam bemoadam, teren chulakin it leyisrael behu i missitra demalka, chulaka illaa it leyisrael beh, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem vegomer, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo. vei missitra illaa dekodesh, chulaka illaa it leyisrael beh, dichtiv veanshe kodesh tihyun li, uchetiv (yirmeya 2) kodesh yisrael laAdonai. veal da lechu itchaze lezammena lehu, uletakkena kammayyhu chedvavta useudata ulemechode behu.

Uman dimzammen leochora (sefer acher learcha), bae leachazaa leh chedu, veanpin nehirin leattera (nusach acher lenatra) orcheh dehahu ushepiza. lemalka dezammin ushepiza yakkira, amar livne hechaleh, kol shear yomin havitun kol chad vechad beveteh, da avid avidteh, veda azil bischorateh, veda azil bechakleh. bar hahu yoma dili, dechulchon mitarin (sefer acher mateateday) bechedvavta dili, hasheta zeminit ushepiza illaa veyakkira, la baena detishtaddelun baavidta, vela bischorata, vela bemadbere, ella kulchu izdemanu, kegavvna dehahu yoma dili, veatkinu garmayychu lekabbela lehahu ushepiza, beanpin nehirin, bechedvavta betushebachta. atkinu leh seudata yakkira, begin dihe zemini dili bechol sitrin.

Kach amar kudesha berich hu leyisrael, banay, kol shear yomin attun mishtaddele baavidta bischorata, bar hahu yoma dili. hasheta ushepiza illaa veyakkira zeminit, attun kabbilu leh, beanpin nehirin, zaminu leh, atkinu leh seudate illae, patore mesadderan, kegavvna dehahu yoma dili. begin kach tikreu otam bemoadam.

Ta chaze, beshaata deyisrael letatta chadan behane moadayya, umeshabbechin shevacha lekudesha berich hu, mesadderin patore, metakkene garmayyhu bemane yekar, malache illae amrin, ma tivan deyisrael bechach. kudesha berich hu amar, ushepiza illaa it lon yoma da. amre velav dilach hu, mehahu atar deikre kodesh. amar lon vechi yisrael lav kodesh ninhu, veikrun kodesh, lon itchaze lezammena ushepiza dili, chad missitra dili, deha innun devekim bi. vechad missitra dekodesh, dichtiv (yirmeya 2) kodesh yisrael laAdonai, hoil veyisrael ikrun kodesh, ushepiza dilhon hu vadday, begin dizminu dehay ushepiza mikkodesh hu, dichtiv mikrae kodesh. patchu kullehu veamru, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo.

Telata innun zeminin mikkodesh, vela yoter. chag hammatzot. vechag hashshavuot. vechag hassukkot. amar leh ribbi abba, vechi shabbat lav mikkodesh hu zammin. amar leh lav, bitre sitrin, chad, dehu vadday kodesh ikre, dichtiv, (Shemot 31:14) ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi lachem. vechad, deshabbat lav zammin hu, deha yeruta dileh hu vadday. yeruta dekodesh hu yarit, velav zemini. veal da kullehon zeminin bakkodesh, umitkashsheran beshabbat, umitatteran beh. behay, yoma sheviaa itattar beh, veal da shabbat lav zammin hu.

Livra deal leveta daavoy veimmeh, veachal veshate, beshaata dehu bae. lemalka dehava leh bera yechiday, chaviva denafsheh, yahav leh shushevina lenatra leh, uleitchabbera behu. amar malka, yaut hu lezammena leillen shushevinin divri, uleachzaa yekara vachavivuta dili behu, zammin lon lehane shushevinin. bera la itchaze lezammena, ella lemeal ulemechal ulemishte beveta daavoy, beshaata deihu bae. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:11) mi chamocha baelim Adonai mi kamocha nedar bakkodesh,
1221: Nedar bakkodesh vadday, kevar deittekan (sefer acher deittakkaf) baavoy, nedar bakkodesh, velav zammin mikkodesh.

Sheshet yamim tease melacha, sheshet yamim may avidtayyhu. amar ribbi yose, ketiv ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz, vela ketiv besheshet. veha ukemuha, vechol yoma veyoma avid avidteh, veikrun yome melacha.
Amar ribbi yitzchak i hachi amay ikrun sheshet yeme chol, amay chol. amar ribbi yose, hasheta itnehig alma (248) al yeda dishluchayyhu, begin kach yome chol ikrun.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, begin deshare lemebad behon avidta, uvegin da la ikrun kodesh. uman delav ikrun kodesh, chol ikrun. veal da atkinu chavrayyay behavedala, ben kodesh lechol. may havedala hacha. ella kodesh milla begarmeh hu, veshara minneh atyayn. veal da illen leovada, veillen lenatra. veematay ishtechach netiru behu. kad zeminin mikkodesh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, chedvavta unetiruta deyoma deshabbeta al kolla hu, uvegin deha yoma itattar beabba veimma, veitosaf kedushsha al kedushshateh, ma dela ishtechach hachi bishar yome, deha hu kodesh, veitattar bakkodesh, veosif kedusha al kedushshateh. begin kach hay yoma chedvavta deillae vetattae, kolla chadan beh. male birchan bechullehu almin. kullehu minneh itkanu (nusach acher ittezanu), behay yoma nayycha deilae vetattae. behay yoma nayycha dechayyayvayya degehinam.

Lemalka deavad hilula livreh yechidai, attar leh beitra illaa, mane leh malka al kolla. behay yoma chedvavta lecholla. chad santira deitpekad al dina divne nasha, havo bideh guverin devayayn kattula, guverin devayayn lealkaa. begin yekara dehay yoma dechedvevta demalka, shavik dinoy, venatar lechedvavta demalka.

Kach hahu yoma, hilula demalka bematronita, chedvavta deabba veimma aleh, chedvavta deillain vetattain. bechedvavta demalka, kullehu chaddan, vela yitztaarun beh. al da ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg. may oneg. oneg la ishtechach ella leella baatar dekodesh illaa share. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. dehay oneg al Adonai hu. vehay yoma dehu hilula demalka, itattar behahu itra deoneg hada hu dichtiv vekarata lashshabbat oneg. ma dela ishtechach hachi bishar yomin.

Behay yoma, telat seudatan bayayn bene malka, lezammena, ulesaddera patore. begin yekara demalka, kema deokimna. vechad izdeman beh chagga, o zemana, la yesadder bar nash tere patore bechol seudata, chad leshabbat, vechad leushepiza, begin dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 9:13) al shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel, sippuka hu befatora demalka, lehahu ushepiza deatya leh. veal da bae bar nash lesaddure patora shelema lemalka, vehu yahiv minneh leushepiza.

Amar ribbi elazar, seudata telitaa deshabbat, kad ira beh oshpiza, shavkin leh o la shavkin leh, i la shavkin leh, ishtechach ushepiza dechayyay mippatora demalka, i shavkin leh, ishtechach pegimu bisudata demalka.

Amar leh ribbi shimon avoy, lemalka deira beh ushepiza, venatil mechla mikkammeh, vesalleka leushepizeh, ishtechach af al gav demalka la achal immeh, mimmechla demalka ka achil, umalka yahiv leh lemechal. vechol da, begin dehu ushepize demalka. uveve rav hamenuna sava, la chayyshe leushepiza beshaata da, ulevatar mesaddere patora leoshpiza.
Behay yoma millula asir, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, utenan cheftzecha ketiv, begin dehay yoma kol mehemnuta itkeshar beh.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, vehech avidna dela lesaddera (sefer acher lesalleka) seudata demalka leushepiza, deha arbesar dechal lihyot beshabbat, salleka seudata demalka lefischa, af al gav delav ihu ushepizeh.
Amar leh hachi amena dei hu ushepizeh, (kol hahu yoma) yachla lesalleka leh, vei lav la salleka leh. vei nema 18 dechal
1222: Lihyot beshabbat, itdachyay seudata demalka mikkamme seudata defischa. shane pesach, disudata deshabbat itdachyay bechamma gavvnin. chad, begin matzot umerorim, devae bar nash deyishtechach taiva. vechad, begin pesach veha nahama la ishtechach 46 shaot ulemala, desiddura defatora bela nahama, lav hu siddura.

Vei tema bechamra, chamra share, begin detaiv (sefer acher degarer sefer acher dagebayr) libba. aval miomay ishtaddallena dela batilna seudata deshabbat, afillu innun yome, deishtechach beh. behay yoma chakal detappuchin kaddishin itberach, umitbarchan illain vetattain, vehay yoma kishura hu deorayyta.

Amar ribbi abba, hachi hava avid ribbi shimon, bezimna deistellak seudata deshabbata, mesadder patoreh veishtedal bemaase merkava, vahava amar ha seudata demalka deyete lemechal gabbay. begine kach, shabbat, ishtechach becholla adif mikkol zimnin vechaggin, veikre kodesh vela mikra kodesh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kullehu moadim mikrae kodesh karenan behu. aval nafke rosh hashshana veyoma dechippura dela ishtechach behu chedvavta, deha innun dina havo, aval illen telata, zeminin mikkodesh, lechedvavta lecholla, leishtashea behu bekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 12:12) usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem, uchetiv (Devarim 27:7) vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha. behay yoma deshabbeta, itneshe kol tzaara vechol rugeza vechol dochaka mikkol alma, begin deihu yoma dehilula demalka, denishmatin ittosfan, kegavvna dealma deate.

Amar ribbi yitzchak leribbi yehuda, ketiv (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho, vetanenan zachrehu al hayyayin, amay al hayyayin. amar leh, begin deyayin chedvavta deorayyta, veyena deorayyta, chedvavta hu decholla. vehay yayin chadde lemalka, vehay yayin meattera lemalka beitroy, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo. vetanenan becholla bayay leachazaa bar nash ovada. dela ishtechach kedushsha ella beyayin, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 1:4) ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, miyyayin innun tavaan, nazkira dodecha miyyayin. veal da kidusha deshabbat beyayin, veha ukemuha, veha ittemar.

(Vayikra 23:6) uvachodesh harishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) ani yeshena velibbi er kol dodi dofek vegomer. amra keneset yisrael, ani yeshena begaluta demitzrayim, dahavo banay beshibuda dekashyu. velibbi er, lenatra lehu dela yishtetzun begaluta. kol dodi dofek, da kudesha berich hu, deamar (Shemot 6:Adonai) vaezkor et beriti.

Pitchi li pitcha kechiduda demachata, vaana aftach lecha tarin illain. pitchi li achoti, deha pitcha leala li, bach hu, dela yealun legabbay banay ella bach, annet hu pitcha leala li (bach), i ant la tiftach pitchach, ha ana sagir. dela yishkechun li. begin kach, pitchi li. pitchi li vadday. veal da amar david, kad baa leaala lemalka, amar (Tehillim 118:19-20) pitchu li shaare tzedek, avo vam ode yah. ze hashshaar laAdonai, da hu pitcha vadday leaala lemalka. ze hashshaar laAdonai, leashkecha leh, uleitdabbeka beh, veal da pitchi li achoti rayati sheroshi vegomer. begin leizdavvevga immach, ulemehevi immach bishlam dealmin.

Ta chaze, beshaata dekudesha berich hu hava katil levuchere demitzrae, kol innun dekatal befalgut lelya, veachit dargin meella letatta. beh shaata alu yisrael bekiyyuma deat kaddisha, itgezaru veishtattafu bichneset yisrael, veitachadu bah. keden hahu dama achziu leh al pitcha. uteren dame havo, chad defischa, vechad dama deitgezaru. vahava rashim al pitcha, reshima dimhemnuta, chad hacha vechad hacha vechad benayyhu, veha ittemar, (Shemot 12:7) venatnu al shete hamezuzot veal hammashkof, begin leachazaa mehemnuta.
Uvearbaa (nusach acher uvachamishsha) asar, ha ittemar, deha keden mevattelin chametz useor, veistallaku yisrael mershuta ochora, veitakaru minneh, veitachadu bemmatza,
1223: Kishshura kaddisha. batar deitgezaru, alu bah, ad deitperau, veitgalyay reshima dilhon, ucheden yahav lehon kishshura, baatar illaa, bekishshura dimhemnuta, baatar dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim, min hashshamayim dayyka, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, bearbesar (nusach acher bachamesar) beshaata deziuuga desihara ishtechach bishlimu im shimsha, vechitrin tattain la mishtakkechin kol kach bealma, deha bechadtute desihara, zinin bishin mishtakkechin, umitare leitpashta bealma. uveshaata deziuuga desihara ishtechach binhiru deshimsha bishlimu, mitkanneshe kullehu laatar chad, vekiddushe malka attearu. keden ketiv (Shemot 12:42) lel shimmurim hu laAdonai, deha ziuuga kaddisha ishtechach, vehu shimmurim becholla.

Ribbi acha amar, begin kach tikkuna decholla (nusach acher dechullah) behahu yoma, uvelelya ishtechach yishshuva deveta, vavy leinnun delav mibbene beta ninhu, kad atan leizdavvga orayyta (sefer acher aryevavta) kachada, vavy leinnun dela ishtemodan gabbayyhu. begin kach yisrael kaddishin metakkenin lon beta, kol hahu yoma, veal yedayyhu, ayyle man deayyle, veinnun chaddan vezammeran tarvavyyhu zakkain innun yisrael bealma den uvealma deate.

Amar ribbi yose lamma lan leatrecha kule hay, kera shelim hu, deha behay lelya, ziuuga illaa kaddisha ittear veishtechach, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 12:42) hu hallayla hazze laAdonai shimmurim, may shimmurim. tere, ziuuga desihara beshimsha. lechol bene yisrael ledorotam, deha mikkan ulehala, itachadu veitkashsharu bekishshura dishma kaddisha, venafku mershuta ochora. begine kach bearbaa asar, metakkene garmayyhu, umevaare chametz mibbenayyhu, veayyle birshuta kaddisha, ucheden mitattere chatan vechalla, beitroy deima illaa, uvae bar nash leachazaa garmeh deihu bar chorin.

Amar ribbi yose, hane arba kase dehahu lelya amay. amar ribbi abba, ha ukemuha chavrayyay, lokovel 4 geulot. aval shappir hu besifra derav yesa sava, dekaamar hoil veziuuga kaddisha ishtechach behay lelya bechol sitrin, veziuuga hu bearba kishrin, deinnun 4 dargin, vela mitparshe da min da, kad ziuuga da ishtechach, vanan bechedvavta dilhon ittearna, begin deha zachena behu, deman deachid beda, zache becholla. veal da ishtane lelya da mikkol shear lelavavn, uvaenan lemebad shema becholla, ulemechde behay lelya, begin dechedvevta hu leella vetatta.

Veod amar, dearba illen arba geulot karenan lehu. may tama. begin dehay darga batraa, goel itkere, (Bereshit 48:16) hammalach haggoel. vela ikre goel, ella al yeda dedarga ochora illaa, (Shemot 126, Rosh Chodesh amud bet) dekayyeyma alah venahir lah. veda la appik lah nehora, ella beillen teren (sefer acher beinnun dargin) dargin dealeh. ishtechach, ded illen arba geulot ninhu.

Ribbi yehuda shaal leribbi abba, ha ketiv (sefer acher hay dichtiv) shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem, vechedvavta hu kol shiva, amay la ishtelim hallel kol 7 yomin, kemo bessukkot, deishtechach 8 yomin hallela, bishlimu dechedvevta kol yoma veyoma.

Amar leh shappir kaamart, aval yedia hu, deha hacha la itkashsharu yisrael kol kach becholla, kema deitkesharu levatar. begin kach behay lelya, deziuuga ishtechach (bechol inun dargin illain) vechedvavta decholla ishtechach, veyisrael itkashsharu behahu chedvavta, avidna shelimu, vehallela ishtelim. (aval beinnun dargin illain) aval levatar af al gav dechullehu mishtakkeche, ad kean yisrael la itkashsharu behu, vela itperau leitgalyay reshima kaddisha, vela kabbilu orayyta, vela alu bema dealu levatar. begin kach bassukkot shelimu decholla ishtechach beh, vechedvavta decholla yattir, aval hacha ad kean la zachu, vela ishtechach shelimu beh kol kach, af al gav deishtechachu kol 7, lav hu beitgalyay, veyisrael ad la itkeshsharu behu kadka chaze. \

Veal da chedvavta decholla ushelimu dehalela behay lelya, begin hahu chulaka deitkesharu beh. may taama. dechevan divhahu lelya ziuuga ishtechach, kol kishshura decholla ishtechach besitra deziuuga, vela besitra deyisrael, dechad ziuuga ishtechach bah mishtakkeche illen teren
1224: (Sefer acher telat) dargin dekayymin ala. vechad illen mishtakkeche, ha kol gufa ishtechach behu, ucheden shelimu decholla, vechedvavta micholla, vehallela ishtelim, deha keden itatterat sihara becholla. aval la levatar, dechol yoma veyoma ishtachche, veyisrael ad la zachu behu, ha lav hallela shelema, kemo bezimnin ochoranin.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, shappir hu, vehachi hu vadday. vehay zimna ochora shemana leh behay gavvna, veanshena mille. hasheta milla ochora baena leminda, ha chazena bappesach 7, uvesukkot 7, ushelimu dechedvavta beyoma ochora. beshavuot, amay la ishtechachu beh 7 yamim, veha hacha itchazun yattir mikkolla.

Patach veamar, (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz. vechi may shena hacha deikrun yisrael echad, yattir meatar ochora. ella, kevan dishvacha deyisrael, atyay lefarsha, kara lon echad, deha bechol atar shevacha deyisrael echad hu. may tama. begin dechol keshiru deilae vetattae, behay atar deikre yisrael ishtechach. (veod) deitkeshar bema dilella, veitkeshar bema diltatta, veitkeshar bikkeneset yisrael. veal da ikre kolla echad. uvaatar da ishtemoda mehemnuta, vekishshura shelema, veyichuda illaa kaddisha.

Veal da, yoma da, kishshura dimhemnuta hu, kishshura decholla. uchetiv (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah ilana hu deikre echad. veal da begin deinnun mitkashshere baatar da, ikre hachi. veetz chayyim echad hu vadday ikre, begin decholla beh itkeshar, veyoma (sefer acher veshemma) dileh, echad vadday, kishshura decholla, veemtzaita decholla.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:9) veetz hachayyim betoch haggan, betoch mammash, bimtziut, veachid bechol sitrin, veitkeshar beh. veal da pesach vesukkot, vehu beemtzaita. begin deihu emtzaita decholla, veda hu shevacha deorayyta behay yoma, vela yattir, shevacha dimhemnuta, vekishshura decholla. amar ribbi yehuda, berich rachamana deshailna, vezachena lehane mille.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, chedvavta veshirata, zeminin yisrael leshabbecha lekudesha berich hu, kehay shevacha dimshabbeche yisrael belelya defischa, dekneset yisrael itkaddeshat bikdushsha demalka. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:29) hashshir yihye lachem kelel hitkaddesh chag. kelel hitkaddesh chag dayyka. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen.

Uveyom (Bamidbar 28:26) habbikkurim behakerivchem mincha chadasha laAdonai beshavuotechem mikra kodesh yihye lachem vegomer. rabbi shimon patach, (divrei hayamim 1 16:33) az yerannenu atze hayyaar millifne Adonai ki va lishpot et haaretz. zakkaa chulakehon deinnun demishtaddele beorayyta yemama velele, deyadin archoy dekudesha berich hu, veitachadan bishmeh (kol yoma). vavy leinnun dela mishtaddele beorayyta, deha let lon chulaka bishma kaddisha, vela itachadan beh, la behay alma, vela bealma deate. man dezache behay alma, zache bealma deate. dehachi tanenan, (Shir HaShirim 7:10) dovev sifte yeshenim, af al gav deinnun behahu alma, sifvavtayyhu merachshan tamman orayyta.

Ta chaze, ad hasheta akrivu yisrael tevuat haaretz, tevuat haaretz vday. veitasseku beh, veitkashsharu behahu kishshura. veaf al gav dedina ishtechach, dina bishlama ishtechach beh. (sefer acher dealma itnehig beh) veakrivu seorim, begin deihu kadmaa mikkol shear tevua, umin kadmaa mitkarva, vela mehahu demitacher, deha achidu kadmaa, deyisrael itachadu beh bekudesha berich hu, hacha hu. amar kudesha berich hu, ana yahavit lechu man bemadbera, mehahu atar deikre shamayim, dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim, veattun mekarvin kammay seorim.

Veraza demilla, zot torat hakkenaot, chaser. azharuta lenashe alma, dela yistun techot baalehon. vei lav, kemach seorim zemina lekarva. umimmila chada, ishtemoda milla ochora. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deha keneset yisrael la shakrat bemalka kaddisha lealmin. keneset yisrael tavvavhat, (Bamidbar Adonai:29) asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah, begin kach dina dehay itteta
1225: Meatraha ka atyay. uman hu atraha hahu dichtiv bah (Mishlei 31:10) eshet chayil mi yimtza verachok mippeninim michrah. (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret baalah.

Vehahu kemach seorim, deayytit hahi itteta, minchat kenaot itkere, chaser, keneset yisrael hachi ikre. veal da, befinchas ketiv, (Bamidbar 25:13) tachat asher kinne lelohav, dekina hacha itachad, deman dimshakker behay berit, kina ittearat aleh, veal da kannain pogin bo. ta chaze, kemach seorim, hay omer, dechevan dehava mata lerechayyin digrusot, mefikin minneh issaron menuppe beyg nappa.

Veda sheva shabbatot temimot, levatar desallekin sheva shabbatot illen, ata malka kaddisha leizdavvevga bah bikkeneset yisrael, veorayyta ityeyhivat. ucheden itattar malka beyichuda shelim, veishtechach echad leella vetatta. vechad attear malka kaddisha, umata zimna deorayyta. kol innun ilanin dimvakkere ibbayyhu, sallekin shirata. umay amre beshaata dimlakte lehon, patche veamre, (Tehillim 103:19) Adonai bashamayim hechin kiso umalchuto bakkol mashala. (Tehillim 36:6) Adonai behashshamayim chasdecha. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 55:12) vechol atze hasade yimchau chaf.

Tu patach veamar, (Tehillim 98:1) mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa. shir chadash ikre. begin kach behakerivchem mincha chadasha. hatam minchat kenaot, hacha mincha chadasha. chadasha dechiddusha decholla (sefer acher dechullah) hacha. kishshura decholla deella vetatta, kishshura dimhemnuta. veal da yaakov shelema itattar beitroy, veorayyta ityeyhivat.

Vechad matun bikkurim legabbe kahana, hava bae bar nash lememar ulefarsha millin, al hahu ilana deara, deishtelim kegavvna dilella, bitresar techumin, beshivin anpin, uvaa leovada leh lavan aramaa, deitpegim alma begineh. vekudesha berich hu sheziv leh, veitattar bedinoy (sefer acher bivnoy) kema deokimna. begin hahu ilana, dechol kishra dimhemnuta, beh talyay. veal da mincha chadasha itkere. may tama. begin dechedvavta deilae vetattae hu, vechedvavta desihara. uvechol zimna chadtute desihara, kishra dimhemnuta hu, vechedvavta dilah. (desihara)

Lemalka dahavo leh benin, uveratta chada, atkin seudata lechullehu benin, la ishtechachat hahi beratta al patora. kad atat, amrat lemalka, mari, lechol achay zeminat veyahavat lechol chad manin yedian, veli la yahavat chulaka benayyhu. amar leh, chayyayich berati, mana dilach yishtekach al chad teren. ha kolla yittenun lach mechulakehon. ishtechach levatar bidaha chulakin, al chad teren mikkola. kach keneset yisrael, mikkolla natla chulakin, veal da itkere kalla, kelula. kachalla dechullehu mezamnin lah manin vechulakin vetachshitin, kach hi keneset yisrael, chadtute (nusach acher chedvavta) dilah becholla, vecholla yahavin lah chulakin umanin.

Ta chaze, beshaata demalka kaddisha ishtechach beitroy, chedvavta dichneset yisrael hu. vechad orayyta ityeyhivat, itatterat keneset yisrael beitrin illain, uvegin dechol kishra dimhemnuta, itkeshar behay ilana, ikre yom echad. dichtiv, (Zecharya 14) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai. yom echad vadday, dekneset yisrael yom echad, bekishshura dilella.

Kishshura dilella, resha vegulegalta umoche. (vaychi 221) kishshura ochora, teren deroin vegufa. daachidan, (kishshura achara) mechela deresha. veokma rav hamenuna, (sefer acher bitren) bitlat keshirin daavahata (kishshura achara). teren kayaymin (nusach acher kavelayyn diltatta) deitmeshachu bimshach revut, (bekiyyuma) bitren dargin, teren nachalin, leachnasha zara, leappaka bedarga ochora, befum amma. ilana da, hu gufa deemtzaita, deachid lechol hane, vecholla mitkashsheran beh, vehu behon, veal da kolla chad. vechad izdavvgat beh matronita, keden hu echad, veha okimna mille.

Ta chaze, ketiv bayyom hashshemini atzeret. man atzeret. ella behahu atar, decholla mitkashsheran kachada, ikre atzeret, may atzeret, (sefer acher kenufeya kenishu) kenishu. vei tema hacha deikre atzeret, may taama. ella bechol innun yomin, yome seudate deanfe ilana
1226: Havo. veal da, shivim parim innun. levatar, chedvavta (degufa) deilana mammash, vechedvavta deorayyta. uvegineh hu yoma chad atzeret. chedvavta deorayyta, chedvavta deilana, dehu gufa.

Veal da let chulaka behay yoma, ella lekudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael. begin kach, atzeret tihye lachem, lachem, vela leochora. (sefer acher levatar chedvavta daalanea mammash uvegineh hu yoma chad velet chulaka behay yoma ella lekudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael veal da ketiv atzeret tihye lachem. uf hachi behay yoma chedvavta daarayytea chedvavta daalanea dehu gufa vecholla ishtechach beh) deha beshaata demalka ishtechach, kolla ishtechach beh. veal da tanenan, baatzeret al perot hailan, veha ukemuha begin kach echad ikre, echad vadday, kema deamaran.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa vegomer, solet tihyena chametz teafena. may shena hacha chametz (bichneset yisrael), ella begin decholla achidan beh (vechen) beilana, deha beilana achidan anfin, beilana achidan alin, kelifin, dinin saggiin bechol sitrin, kolla ishtechach beh. uvegin dehay ilana, mechapper al yetzer hara, dehu beve motveh devar nash.

Amar ribbi elazar, mehay ilana ittezanu kol shear ilanin letatta. vehu ishtarsha al chad nahara amika, denagid venafik vela paskin memoy lealmin. aleh ketiv (Yirmeyahu 17:8) vehaya keetz shatul al mayim veal yuval yeshallach sharashav, veal da ikre orayyta, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi vegomer. umay vetomcheha meushshar. ha ukemuha, aval vetomcheha meushshar, kema deat amer (Bereshit 30:13) beashri ki ishsheruni banot.

Raya mehemna (Vayikra 23:11) vehenif et haomer vegomer. pikkuda da, (32) lekarva karban haomer, karbena da, kolla ihu bidvekuta ella vetatta, matronita uvenaha kachada azlin. omer da, mekarvin yisrael bedachyuta dilhon, vehahu karbena ihu min seorim, veda itkerivu, lemeal rechimu ben itteta uvalah.

Eshet zenunim, itrachakat garmah mibbenayyhu, dela yachilat lemekam al gabbah. eshet chayil kerivat garmah lekarva legabbe kahana rabba, vadday tehora hi, (Bamidbar Adonai:28) venikketa venizrea zara, veosifat chela urechimu legabbe balah. eshet zenunim arkat min makdesha, dela lemikrav legabbeh, deilmale behahu zimna deeshet chayil ivdikat garmah, ihi itkerivat legabbah, itavidat mealma. veal da la baya lekarva lemakdesha, vearkat minneh, veishtaaru yisrael zakkain, bela irbuveya ochora, legabbe raza dimhemnuta.

Raza desitra da, tarten achatan. vechad archat da legabbe da, bivdiku dilah, tzavta vitnah venafla yerechah. deha bediku deeshet chayil, sama demota leeshet zenunim. veda ihu eta, deyahav kudesha berich hu livnoy, lekarva karbena da begin eshet chayil, detaarok eshet zenunim minnah. veishtaaru yisrael bela irbuveya ochora, zakkain innun bealma den, uvealma deate. Raya mehemna (Vayikra 23:15) usefartem lachem mimochorat hashshabbat vegomer. pikkuda (31) da, lispor sefirat haomer, ha okimna, veraza da, yisrael, af al gav deitdachu lemebad pischa, venafku mimmesaavu, la havo shelemin vedachyayn kadka chaze. veal da, lav hallel gamur beyome defischa, dead kean la ishtelimu kadka yaut.
Keitteta denafka mimmesaavu, vechevan denafka, mittamman ulehala, vesafra lah. uf hacha yisrael, kad nafku mimmitztzerayim, nafku
1227: Deitachadu beh, pesak mesaavuta minnayyhu, keda itteta kad pasku minnah deme mesaavuta. batar deitpesaku minnah, ma ketiv. (Vayikra 15:28) vesafra lah shivat yamim. uf hacha, kevan dealu bechulaka kaddisha, paska mesaavu minnayyhu, veamar kudesha berich hu, mikkan ulehala chushebana ledachyuta.

Usefartem lachem, lachem dayyka, kema deat amer vesafra lah shivat yamim, lah: leatzmah. uf hacha lachem: leatzmechem. velamma. begin leitdakkea bemayin illain kaddishin, ulevatar lemete leitchabbera beh bemalka, ulekabbela orayyteh.

Hatam vesafra lah shivat yamim, hacha sheva shabbatot, amay sheva shabbatot. begin lemizke leitdakkea bemayin, dehahu nahar denagid venafik. veikre mayim chayyim. vehahu nahar, sheva shabbatot nafku minneh. veal da sheva shabbatot vadday, begin lemizke beh, kema deitteta, dachyu dilah belelya, leishtammesha bevalah.

Kach ketiv uveredet hattal al hamachane layla. al hammachane ketiv, vela ketiv uveredet hattal layla. ella al hammachane, begin deyored mehahu nekuda, al innun yomin deitkeriu machane. umitchabberet bemalka kaddisha, veematay nachat hay tala. kad kerivu yisrael letura desinay, keden nachat hahu talla bishlimu, veiddakke, veitpaskat zuhamatan minnayyhu, veitchabbaru beh bemalka ucheneset yisrael, vekabbilu orayyta, veha okimna. uvehahu zimna, vadday kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam, leitdakkea uleistachaa, vecholla itkashsharu (sefer acher itkaddashu) veitchabbaru beh bemalka kaddisha.

Ta chaze, kol bar nash dela manne chushevana da, innun sheva shabbatot temimot, lemizke ledachyuta da. la ikre tahor, velav bichlala detahor hu. velav hu keday lemeheve leh chulaka beorayyta, uman demate tahor lehay yoma, vechushebana la itavid minneh, kad mate lehay lelya, live leh lemile beorayyta, uleitchabbera ba, ulenatra dachyu illaa, demate aleh behahu lelya, veitdeche.

Mimmesaavu, veavdu pesach, lemechal befatora deavuhon, umittamman ulehala yaavdun chushevana, lemikrav itteta levalah, leitchabbera bahadeh, veinnun chamshin yomin dedachyu, leaala leraza dealma deate, ulekabbela orayyta, ulemikrav itteta levalah.

Uvegin deillen yomin, yomin dealma didchura, la itmesar chushebana da ella legavre bilchodayyhu. veal da chushebana da, baamida ihu, umillin dealma tattaa, bishiva, vela baamida. veraza da, tzelota deamida, utztzelota meyushav.

Veillen chamshin, 49 innun, kelal anpe orayyta, deha beyoma dechamshin, ihu raza deorayyta mammash. veillen innun chamshin yomin, deveh shemita veyovla. vei tema, chamshin, 49 innun. chad temira ihu, vealma istemich aleh. uvehahu yoma dechamshin, itgalya temira, veitkasya (nusach acher veishtechach) beh. kemalka deate leve shushevineh, veishtechach tamman, uf hacha yoma dechamshin, veha okimna raza da. Pikkuda (33) batar da, lemebad chag shavuot, dichtiv veasita chag shavuot laAdonai elohecha. shavuot: al dealu yisrael leraza dechamshin yomin, deinnun shiva shavuot, uvekarbena deomer, itbetal yetztzer hara, dearkat meeshshet chayil. vechad tamman la itkeriv, mitdabbekin yisrael bekudesha berich hu, veitbetal meella umittatta.

Uvegin kach ikre begavvna da atztzeret, deit beh bitul yitztzer hara. veal da la ketiv beh chatat, kishar zemanin, dichtiv behu chatat (laAdonai). ucheden kol nehorin itkenashu leeshet chayil, uvegin kach atztzeret.

Shavuot, vela ketiv kama innun. ella bechol atar deittemar setam, shema garim deinnun min sheva. uchetiv shiva shavuot tispor lach, amay ketiv shavuot bilchodoy. ella hachi itztzetrich shavuot setam, leachlela ella vetatta, deha bechol atar deillen mitare, illen uf hachi mitare immehon. ad la hava shelomo, la havo itgalyayn, kevan deata shelomo, aved minnayyhu perat. dichtiv, (Melachim 1 8:65) shivat yamim veshivat yamim, da ihu perat.

Bizmana ochora bichlal, shavuot setam. vela itztzetrich levar nash ochora lemebad minnehon perat, bar shelomo. begin deinnun shivat yamim diltatta, la nehiru bishlimu, ad deata shelomo, ucheden kayyeyma sihara beashlemuta, beinnun shivat yomin. vehacha chag shavuot setam, begin deitkelalu tattae beillae, vela anhiru keyoma dishlomo.
1228: Deorayyta devae leh lemile behay lelya, orayyta debal pe, begin deyitdechun (sefer acher deyitdabbak) kachada, mimmabbua denachala amika. levatar, behay yoma, lete tora shebbichtav, veyitchabber (sefer acher behu) bah, veyishtachchun kachada beziuuga chad leella. keden machrize aleh veamre, (Yeshayahu 59:21) vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai ruchi asher alecha udevaray asher samti beficha vegomer.

Veal da, chaside kadmae la havo nayyme behay lelya, vahavu laan beorayyta, veamre, nete leachasana yeruta kaddisha, lan, velivnan, bitren almin. vehahu lelya keneset yisrael itattera alayyhu, veatyay leizdavvevga beh bemalka, vetarvavyyhu mitattere al reshayyhu, deinnun dezakkan lehachi.

Rabbi shimon hachi amar, beshaata demitkanshe chavrayyay behay lelya legabbeh, nete letakkena tachshite kalla, begin detishtechach lemachar betachshitaha, vetikunaha, legabbe malka kadka yaut. zakkaa chulakehon dechavrayyay, kad yitba malka lematronita, man takkin tachshitaha, veanhir itraha, veshavvi tikkunaha. velet lacha bealma, man deyada letakkena tachshite kalla, ella chavrayyay, zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, chavrayyay metakkene behay lelya tachshitaha lechalla, umeattere lah beitraha, legabbe malka. uman matkin leh lemalka, behay lelya, leishtakkecha bah bechalla, leizdavvevga bah bematronita. nahara kaddisha amika dechol naharin, imma illaa. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo vegomer. levatar deatkinat leh lemalka, veatterat leh, atyayt ledakkea lah lematronita, uleinnun demishtakkeche gabbah.

Da, lekarva shete hallechem. ha okimna, shete hallechem: tarte shechinte, ella vetatta, veitchabberan kachada. legabbehon, teren nahame beshabbat, mezona dechad teren, deella vetatta. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 16:22) shene haomer laechad. laechad vadday, leityaychada baatar chad. lehahu deikre echad. uman ihu. hakkol kol yaakov, deihu yarit ella vetatta, teren nahame kachada. uvegin deshabbat ihu raza deella vetatta, vecholla ihu shabbat, (itkerivu) teren nahame. ad kan

Pikkuda batar da lehasedir lechem ulevona, lehakeriv omer. dichtiv vaasitem beyom hanifchem et haomer keves tamim leola. vechen beshavuot lehakeriv shete hallechem, vehachi bechol yomin tavin, lehakeriv karban demusafin. ella vadday bechol yoma demoadayay tzarich lekarva karbena dileh. tzarich lekarva aleh tosefet deit leh, kegon tosefet ketuvata umattenata, deosif chatan lechalla. veshabbat malketa, deihi kalla, beshabbatot uvechol yomin tavin, tzericha tosefet, deinnun musafin dekarbenin, umattenata, deinnun mattenot kehuna.

Uveshavuot deihu mattan tora, deityeyhivu teren luchin deorayyta, missitra deilana dechayyi, tzarich lekarva legabbayyhu, shete hallechem deinnun 10 ditren yomin deshavuot inun 16 tzarich lekarva legabbayyhu, shete hallechem meinnun 10 deha ihu nahama deorayyta, deittemar beh (Mishlei 9:Adonai) lechu lachamu velachmi, 10, min hammotztzi lechem min haaretz.

Vehay ihu maachol adam, deihu yod hei vav hei. (Bamidbar 19) zot hattora adam. (Vayikra 1) adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai. omer seorin, maachol beiran, deinnun chayyot hakkodesh, deminnehon tzarich lekarva, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 1) min habbehema. elim: menaggechim bematnitin, beillen pashtin. min habbakar: parim menaggechim bematnitin, betukepa yattir. umin hatztzon: shear amma, karbena dilhon tzelotin, vealayyhu ittemar, (Yechezkel 34) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem.

1229: Avne yekar sacharana, veatterat leh. appikat levushin demilat vealbishat leh, veatkkenat leh betikkune demalchin.

Levatar alat leve kalla, chamat ulemtaha, deka metakkene itraha, ulevushaha, vetachshitaha, letakkena lah. amra lon, ha atkkinat be tevila, atar demayin navin, vechol rechin uvusemin sucharane innun mayin, ledakkea lechallati, lete kallati, matronita divri, veulemtaha, veyitdechun behahu atar deatkinat behahu be tevila, demayin navin deimmi. levatar takkinu lah betachshitaha, albishu lah levushaha, aatteru lah beitraha. lemachar kad yete beri leizdavvevga bematronita, yatkin hechala lechullehu, veyishtekach madoreh bechu kachada.

Kach malka kaddisha umatronita, vechavrayyay, kehay gavvna. veima illaa dimtaknat kolla. ishtechach demalka illaa, umatronita, vechavrayyay, madorehon kachada, vela mitparshin lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 15:1) Adonai mi yagur beoholecha vegomer, holech tamim ufoel tzedek. man hu poel tzedek. ella, illen innun dimtakne lematronita betachshitaha, bilvushaha, beitraha. vechol chad, poel tzedek ikre. amar ribbi chiyyay, ilmale la zachena bealma, ella lemishma millin illen dayy. zakkaa chulakehon deinnun demishtaddele beorayyta, veyadin orchoy demalka kaddisha, diruta dilhon beorayyta, alayyhu ketiv (Tehillim 91:14) ki vi chashak vaafalletehu. uchetiv achalletzehu vaachabbedehu.

Dilhon, omer lechem seorim, (Rut 3:15) vayyamad shesh seorim. vayyashet aleha, orayyta dival pe, deshit sidre mishna. aval illen deilana dechayyi, deinnun adam orayyta dilhon, nahama dekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 9:Adonai) lechu lachamu velachmi vehayeynu shete hallechem. chadu kullehu tanain vaamorain, veamru man kaim kamme sinay. Raya mehemna pikkuda (42) da litkoa shofar berosh hashshana dehu yoma dedina kamma deokimna veha ukemuha dichtiv (Tehillim 81:4) tiku bachodesh shofar, bakkese leyom chaggenu veha ittemar. dehay ihu yoma desihara itkasse beh vekaim alma bedina. begin dehahu mekatrega chafe vekase veanal pitcha al malka atar dedina sharya lemitba dina al alma.

1230: Vihoshua havo yade, amay ketiv ko amar Adonai. ella vadday setima demilla, tivu saggi avad kudesha berich beyisrael, deitree behu baavahata, veavid lon reticha kaddisha illaa likareh, veappik lon miggo nahara illaa yakkira kaddisha, butzina dechol butzinin, begin deyitattar behu. hada hu dichtiv, ko amar Adonai beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam. hannahar: hahu nahar deishtemoda, veityeyda.

Meolam, may ka bae hacha. ella leachazaa chachmeta. meever hannahar meolam, ella hahu nahar olam ikre. veal da, beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam, leachazaa tivu ukeshot deavad kudesha berich hu leyisrael. vaekkach et avichem et avraham meever hannahar may ka mayyre. ella avraham la itdevak beh behahu nahar, kemo yitzchak deitdevak beh besitre leittakkefa.

Ta chaze, hay nahar, af al gav delav ihu dina, dinin nafke missitreh, veittakafu beh. vechad yitzchak ittakkaf (bedinoy) bivnoy, keden illain vetattain mitkannefe ledina, vechuresyay dedina ittakkan, umalka kaddisha yativ al kuresyay dedina, vedain alma, keden, tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu. zakkain innun yisrael, deyadin lesalleka kuresyay dedina, uletakkena kuresyay derachame. uvemma. bashshofar.

Ribbi abba hava yativ kammeh deribbi shimon, amar leh, ha zimnin saggiin shailna al hay shofar, may ka mayyre, vead kan la ityeyshshavna beh. amar leh, vadday hay hu berira demilla, deyisrael bayayn beyoma dedina (nusach acher da), shofar, vela keren. begin dekeren ha ityeyda bean atar ihu, uleitdabbeka dina la baena. aval ha tanenan, bemillin uveovada, baenan leachazaa uleatara millin setimin.

1231: Deyitzchak, tushebachteh daavahan, kad istelak hahu shofar gadol, dela yanka livnin, keden yitzchak ittakkaf, veittakkan ledina bealma.

Vechad ittear hay shofar vechad bene nasha tayyvin mechataehon, bayayn lenagda kol shofar mittatta, vehahu kala salik leella, keden ittear shofara ochora illaa, veittear rachame, veistallak dina. uvaenan leachazaa ovada beshofar, leitteara shofara ochora, uleappaka behay shofar letatta, innun kale, leachazaa dechol innun kalin dilella, dichlilan kullehu behahu shofar illaa, yittearun lenafka.
