Ucheden malka achmitz dina ad zimna yedia dilma ben kach uven kach yehadderun bitshuva. i yehadderun pitkin nikrain vei lav malka yativ vechol inun deve zechuta kayyme kammeh. karoza kam vechariz peloni eved kach man yolif aleh zechut. i it man deyolif aleh zechut yeut. vei lav ha itmasar lesantira

Vecholla yada 107 ammay itzterich lechol da ella begin begin dela yehe pitra defuma livne alma ella leachazaa decholla avid beorach keshot venicha kammeh man deishteziv min dineh. vei tema mena lan, hay itmasar lachachimin. 87 leman dela yade man debae leistakkala yashgach bamme deihu beitgalleyay veyada bamme deihu besitra deha kolla kegavvna chada kol ma depakkid 107 beara kolla ihu kegavvna dilela.

Yoma 209 ihu yoma dedina umalka yativ bekurseyay dedina santira ka ate vechafe pitcha demalka vetava dina. veaf al gav 111 rachim leh ledina 25 ki ani Adonai ohev mishpat netzach rechimoy divnoy lerechimu dedina. uveshaata desantira kam lammitan millin alayyhu. pakkid lemitka beshofar begin leatara rachame mittatta leela behahu shofar.
Salka hahu kala kelila beesha verucha umaya. veitavid minnayyhu kala chada veitar kala ochora leela. kad hahu kala itar meela umittatta keden kol teanot deka tain hahu mekatrega mitarve

Beyoma 209 nafik yitzchak bilchodoy vekare leesav leatama leh tavshilin dechol alma kefum archoy. deha behahi shata vattichhena enav marot denafik minneh man deachshach appe biryayn veitperash veshachiv al arseh dedina vekare leesav veamar vetzuda li tzeda veasa li matammim vehavia li.
Verivka amra el yaakov bana rechima denafsha bana rechima deitmasar lah miyyoma deitbere alma. uppekiddat leh leatara ihu beinun matammim dileh. veyaakov itar
1232: Veyaakov ittear, vechame leavraham mittakken begisa ochora, keden achidan tarvavyyhu beh beyitzchak, da mehay sitra, veda, mehay sitra vela yachlin tukefoy lenafka levar. vehane telata sidrin, kullehu sidra chad.
Sidra ochora, kala nafik, vesalik, venatil leavraham meatreh, venagid leh letatta, laatar detukefehon deyitzchak sharyayn vekayyman leh leavraham begavavyyhu.

Sidra tinyayna, nafik kala tevira, la takkifa kekadmaa, la dechalish hahu kala detaka, ella dehahu kala lav ihu legabbe yitzchak bekadmita, detamman tukepa takkifa sharya, ella legabbe innun be dina diltatta, deinnun refuyin yattir, vechullehu chaman leavraham legabbayyhu, veitkafyayn kammeh.

Addehachi, sidra telitaa, kala nafik, vesalik, veitattar beresheh deyaakov, venagid leh letatta lehahu atar deinnun gevuran sharyayn, vekaim lokkovlayyhu, avraham mehay sitra, veyaakov mehay sitra, veinnun beemtzaita. keden itkafyayn kullehu, umishtachchin (sefer acher vameshatekakey) beatrayyhu. vehane kullehu sidra ochora tinyayna.

Sidra batraa, devayay lesalleka lon leatrayyhu, uleyayshva (sefer acher valeysheraa) benayyhu leyitzchak kemillekaddemin. begin dehay bae leyashshera leh baatreh, vela yippuk betukefoy levar, keden dinin kullehu itkafyayn, verachamin ittearu.

Al da bae lechavvevna libba ureuta behane kale, ulemehdar betiyyuveta kame marehon. keden kad yisrael metakkene umesaddere kalin biruta delibba kedka yaut, beshofara da, ahdar hahu shofar illaa, vechad ahdar, meattera leh leyaakov, veittakkan kolla. vechuresyay ochora remiu, ucheden chedu ishtechach becholla, vekudesha berich hu merachem al alma. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deyadin lenagda uleamshacha

Mittatta mitlabbesh bitzlotin uvautin. vehakkol kol yaakov behahu shofar deka salik veitar yaakov legabbeh veitkeriv bahadeh veyesh lo vayyochal veitkelil da beda. kevan deitkelil bahadeh vayyave lon yayin da yayin demintera yayin dehu chadu delibba raza dealma deate keden vayyarach et reach begadav tzelota desalkin uvautin vayvarchehu. nach rugeza vechade lavo vecholla ihu rachame.

Kevan deihu itkelil beyaakov kol inun chayyaylin vetukefin verugezin dehavu zeminin itbadderu velo ishtakkachu tamman veyisrael nafkin min dina bechedva ubbevirchan. vayhi ach yatza yatza yaakov meet pene yitzchak aviv beyoma da bechedva ubbevirchan illain veasu achiv ba mitztzedo tain toane meovde dealma. vayyaas gam hu matammim chadid lishaneh lammitan teanot. atkin sahade vayyavo leaviv vayyomer yakum avi yitar bedinoy. vayyochal kamma ovadin bishin dechol alma deka ashkachna

Vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad meod deha lo yachil leitparsha mikkelala deyaakov deihu bechedva. vayyomer mi efo hu hatztzad tzayid bechamma tzelotin uvautin veochel mikkol beterem tavo vaavarachehu gam baruch yihye. kishmoa esav et divre (yitzchak) aviv vayyitzak tzeaka vegomer. dechame deha tzedo lo hava kelum. ad levatar amar leh hinne mishmanne haaretz yihye vegomer. illen takkifin veuchlusin dishar ammin veda kashya leh mikkolla. vayishtom esav et yaakov lemezal avatreh ulekatrega leh tadir.

Veyaakov azil beinun yomin deven rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim arik leishtezava minneh. tav bityuveta shavve garmeh betaanita ad deate rosh hashshana vay keden yade yisrael deesav ba veimmo arba meot ish kullehu mekatrege zeminin lekatrega lon vayyira yaakov meod veyetzer lo sagge bealotoyn uvautin vayyomer yaakov elokay avi avraham vealke avi vegomer. ad denatil eta veamar ki amar achappera panav bammincha haholechet lefanay vayyikkach min habba beyado mincha vegomer izzim matayim uteyashim esrim vegomer
Gemallim vegomer kach hu sitra dileh gemallim hu nachash kamin gamal. beshata
1233: Lemarehon, middina lerachame, uletakkena kullehu almin al yedayyhu.

Ta chaze, lokovel da, telata sifrin petichin beyoma da, uchema derachamin mitarin, vedinin kashyayn itkafyayn vealin leduchetayyhu. kach hu letatta kegavvna dilella, dinin kashyayn itkafyayn veitavaru mealma. uman innun. illen innun reshaim gemurim, deinnun dinin kashyayn deitkafyayn veitavaru mealma. veal da nichtavim venechottamim vechulei. amar ribbi abba, vadday da hu berira demilla, berich rachamana deshailna veravavchna behane mile.
Amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv zichron terua, zikkaron avdenan, lechavvevna libba ureuta, yisrael avdin zikkaron letatta, bema. beovada, begin deyittear milla kehahu gavvna leella.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv (Tehillim 81:4) bakkese leyom chaggenu deitkasya beh sihara. vehech itkasya. ella, kad kayyeyma iva, veshimmesha la nahir, keden sihara itkasya, vela nahir. veal da, mikkamme iva shimsha la nahir, kol shekken sihara deitkasseya vela nehira. veal da bakkese leyom chaggenu, beHei, deitkasya sihara. uvema nahir. kolla betiyyuveta, uvekal shofara, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua keden Adonai beor panecha yehallechun.
Defatte samael laadam arkiv al nachash kamin gamal. tanenan man dechame gamal bechalmeh mita niknesa alav millemala veishteziv minah. vecholla chad.

Ucheden ahadar esav appotrofosa deyaakov veyaakov lo baa duvesheh vuketzy. yaavor na adoni lifne avdo. keden vayyeshev bayyom hahu esav ledarko ematay bishat neila deha itperash meama kaddisha vekv shavik lechovehon vechipper alayyhu. kevan dehahu mekatrega azal behahu dorona veitperash minnayyhu bae kav lemechede bivnoy ma ketiv veyaakov nasa sukkota vayyiven lo bet vegomer. al ken kera sham hammakom sukkot. kevan deyatvu bassukkot ha ishtezivu min mekatrega vekudesha berich hu chade bivnoy. zakkaa chulekehon behay alma uvealma deate:

Ta chaze, behay yoma itkasseyay sihara, vela nahir ad beasor lachodesh, deyisrael tayyvin kullehu betiyyuveta shelemata, veima illaa tavat venaharat lah. vehay yoma nehiru deima natla, veishtechach chedu becholla. veal da ketiv, yom hakkippurim hu. yom kippur mibbae leh, man yom hakkippurim. ella begin ditre nehorin naharin bechad. butzina illaa, nahir levutzina tattaa. uvehay yoma minnehora illaa nahir. vela minnehora deshimsha uvegin kach bakkese leyom chaggenu ketiv.

Ribbi abba shalach leh lerabbi shimon, amar, ematay ziuuga dichneset yisrael bemalka kaddisha. shalach leh, (Bereshit 20:12) vegam amna achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi vattehi li leishsha. itregish ribbi abba, arim kaleh, bacha veamar, ribbi ribbi butzina kaddisha, vavy, vavy lealma kad tippuk minneh, vavy ledara dihon bealma kad tistallak minnehon veyishtaarun yatmin minach. amar leh ribbi chiyyay leribbi abba, hay deshalach lokovlach. may kaamar.

Amar vday lav ziuuga demalka bematronita, ella bezimna denahara meabba illaa, vechad itnahara minneh, karenan lah kodesh deha mibbe abba natla hay. ucheden mizdavvevge kachada, begin demalka kodesh ikre, dichtiv, (yirmeya 2) kodesh yisrael laAdonai, denatil meatar deikre kodesh. keden achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat imi, deha mibbe abba shema da, vela mibbe imma, veal da vattehi li leishsha, leizdavvevga kachada, bezimna da, vela bezimna ochora, bezimna denatla mibbe abba, vela bezimna denatla mibbe imma. veyom hakkippurim ochach, detashmish hammitta asur, begin deziuuga la ishtechach, deha mibbe imma natla, vela mibbe abba. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday zakkaa dara derabbi shimon share begavvih, zakkain innun dekayymin kammeh kol yoma.
Amar ribbi abba, berosh hashshana nivra adam, vekaim bedina kamme mareh, vetav
1234: Betiyyuveta, vekabbil leh kudesha berich hu. amar leh, adam, ant tehe simana livnayich ledare darin, behay yoma kayymin bedina, vei yetuvun ana akabbel lon, veekum mikkuresyay dedina, veetkayyem al kuresyay derachame, vaarachem alayyhu. vedavid amar, (Tehillim 116:1) ahavti ki yishma Adonai et koli tachanunay. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 130:4) ki immecha hasselicha lemaan tivvare. uchetiv, (Tehillim 36:10) ki immecha mekor chayyim beorcha nire or. raya mehemna pikkuda (43) da, leitannaa beyoma dechippure, leachnea gufa venafsha, beraza dechamishsha innuyin, dechamishsha dargin deyoma dechippure. deha mekatrega ka ate leadkera chovehon, kema deittemar. vechullehu betiyyuveta shelemata kamme avuhon. kolla, kema deittemar bechamma duchete. (ad kan raya mehemana) (pikkuda 44 lemiflach kahana vechulei 63 amud alef)

(Vayikra 23:27) ach beasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze yom hakkippurim hu mikra kodesh yihye lachem. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 32:1) ledavid maskil ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa. ledavid maskil, ha tanenan bey zine zimra (nusach acher ittakkan) itkere sefer tehillim, benitzuach, benigun, bemaskil, bemichtam, bemizmor, beshir, beashre, bitfilla, behodaa, behaleluyah, veillaa mechullehu haleluyah, veha ukemuha.

Hacha maskil, atreh yedia, mahu maskil, mayya deachkimu leinnun deshatu lehu, hahu atar (sefer acher dameshatedalen behahu atar) deikre maskil, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 16:20) maskil al davar yimtza tov. uvegin deikre hache, talya beh selicha, cheru dechirin. hada hu dichtiv ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa.

May kesuy chataa. ha ukemuha, dehu kasuy mibbene nasha, hahu chattaa dechav lekudesha berich hu, veode kamme kudesha berich hu. aval (sefer acher kissuy chattaa) ta chaze, kad bar nash chate, vechav zimna chada, uteren utelata, vela ahdar beh, ha chovoy beitgalya innun umefarsseme lon leella, umefarsseme lon letatta. vecharoze azlin kammeh umachreze, istelaku missacharaneh diflanya, nazif hu mimmareh, nazif hu leella, nazif hu letatta, vavy leh defagim diyyukena demareh, vavy leh dela chayish likara demareh, kudesha berich hu galle choveh leella, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 20:27) yegallu shamayim avono veeretz mitkomama lo. vechad bar nash azil beorcha demareh, veishtaddal befulechaneh, veizdeman leh chattaa chad, kolla mechassin illavih, illain vetattain, da ikre kesuy chataa.
Amar leh ribbi abba, ad kean la matit leikara demilla. veshappir kaamart. vehay dekaamru chavrayyay shappir. aval i hachi, mechusse chattaa mibbae leh, mahu kesuy chattaa.

Ella tere mille dechachmeta it beh, vetarvavyyhu hachi. chad kema detanenan, deovadin tavin devar nash avid behay alma, avdin leh behahu alma levusha yakkira illaa, leitlabbesha behu. vechad bar nash atkin ovadin tavin, vegavrin aleh ovadin bishin, veashgach beh kudesha berich hu, veovadoy bishin saggiin, veihu rasha, deishtechach chataa kamme mareh, vetohe al innun tavan daavad bekadmita, ha itavid hu mikkolla, mehay alma, umealma deate. ma avid kudesha berich hu meinnun tavan daaved hay chattaa bekadmita.

Ella kudesha berich hu, af al gav dehahu rasha chattaa itavid. innun tavan vezachyayn la itavidu. it tzadik deazil bearchoy demalka illaa, veatkin levushoy meovadoy, vead la ashlim levushoy, istallak. kudesha berich hu ashlim leh, meinnun ovadin daavad (sefer acher daabad) hay rasha chattaa, veashlim levushoy, leittakkena behu behahu alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 27:17) yachin vetzaddik yilbash. hahu chattaa atkin, vetzadik itchappe mimma deihu takkin, hada hu dichtiv kesuy chataa, (kissuy hu mida dechataah itchafe mecheta) veal da la ketiv mechusse, ella kesuy.

Vechad, deitchappe hahu chattaa dehay zakkaa, beinnun deikrun metzulot yam, deha man denafil bimtzulot yam, la ishtechach lealmin begin demayin chafin alayyhu. (man metzulot yam) kema deat amer, (Micha 7:19) vetashlich
1235: Bimtzulot yam kol chattotam. man metzulot yam. ella raza yakkira hu, veha (ukemuha rabbi shimon amar) okmeh ribbi shimon, veamar, kol innun deatu missitra takkifa, veitachadu bezinin bishin, bechitrin tattain, kegon azazel beyoma dechippure, da ikre metzulot yam. kezafta dechaspa, kad bachanin leh benura, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 25:4) hago sigim mikkasef.

Kach hay, meinnun metzulot yam hu, umetzulot yam ikre, metzulot mehahu yam kaddisha, metzulot, zuhama dechaspa. veal da, kol innun chatain deyisrael sharyayn legavvih (sefer acher legabbeh), vehu kabbil lon, veyishtaavun begavih. may taama. begin deihu chataa ikre. may chataa. girona. veal da hu girona decholla, venatal girona degufa udenafsha. behay yoma nachit hay metzulot yam, zuhama (dechaspa) denafsha, venatil zuhama degufa. man hu zuhama degufa. da innun chovin deitavedu al yede deyetzer hara, deikre mezoham menuval.

Amar ribbi yose, tenan (Vayikra 16:8) venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot, i hachi yekara hu daazazel, chamittun avda deshade advin bemareh, orchoy dealma deavda la natal ella ma deyahiv leh mareh. aval, begin desamael zammin hay yoma bediltora, uvegin dela yehe leh pitra (sefer acher behay adva hu salleka beh) yahavin leh chulaka behay.

Vehay adva miggarmeh hu desalik beh, deamar ribbi yehuda amar ribbi yitzchak, milla illaa ashkachna beadva. adva dihoshua, ketiv beh, (Bamidbar 26:56) al pi haggoral, al pi haggoral vadday, deihu amar da chulaka dihuda, da devinyamin vechulei, vechen kullehu. uf hacha, kevan dechahana shavvi yedoy, innun advin medallege vesallekin bida dechahana, (sefer acher vesallekin advin bida dechahana, inun medallege min yedoy) vesharan beatrayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, vehassair asher ala alav haggoral, ala alav vadday.

Vela da bilchodoy, ella bechol zimna dediltura zamin, veityeyhiv leh reshuta, baenan leshavava lokovleh bema deyitasak, veshavik lon leyisrael. behay yoma dalttora zammin lealla ara. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 1:7) vayomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo. veha tanenan, mishshut baaretz, may hu. ella hay hu dilttora rabba mekatrega deyisrael.

Veha attearu chavrayyay, (devadday) behahi shaata dahavo zeminin yisrael lemebar yamma, uleitpara mimmitzrae, amar, ana avarna beara kaddisha, vachamena dela itchazun illen lemeal begavvav, i annet dain dina, dinayyhu hacha kemitzrae, ma shanyayn illen meillen, o yemutun kullehu kachada, o yehadrun kullehu lemitzrayim. velav ant hu deamart, (Bereshit 15:13) vaavadum veinnu otam 4 meot shana, veha la seliku mechushebanaya ella redu, vela yattir.

Amar kudesha berich hu, may abid, ishtaddeluta baya hacha, leayytaa kerava lokovleh, yahivna leh bema deyitasak, veyyishbok behu levanay, veha ishtechach beman deyitasak, miyyad amar leh, hasamta libbecha el avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz. miyyad palig leh dalttora bemillin, vayaan hassatan et Adonai vayomar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim.

Leraya devae leabera aneh bechad nahara, abar zeeva lekatrega leh beaneh, raya hava chakkim, amar may abid, divod daana abar letalyay, yekatreg hu beane. zakaf enoy, vechama ben ana, chad tayysha meillen tayyshe bara, dehava rav vetakkif. amar, ashde da lokovleh, uveod dimkatrege da beda, abar lechol ana, veyishtezvun minneh.

Kach kudesha berich hu amar, vadday ha tayysha chad rav vetakkif vealim, ashde lekavleh, uveod dehu yishtedal beh, yaavrun banay, vela yishtekach kattegora legabbayyhu. miyyad, vayomer Adonai el hassatan hasamta libbecha. ad dekudesha berich hu zivvivg lehu kachada, dichtiv hinno veyadecha. beod dehu ishtaddal beh, shavik lon leyisrael, vela ishtechach kattegora legabbayyhu.

Uf hachi behay yoma, diltora zammin lealla ara, uvaena leshaddera lekovleh bema deyitasak (kegavvna dileh), uveod deihu ishtaddal beh, shavik lon leyisrael. umatla amre lezilzula deve malka, hav leh zeer chamra, vishabbechach kamme malka. vei lav yemma lemalka milla bisha. lezimnin natlin lah lehahi milla, illae deve malka, umalka avid dina begineh.
1236: Yitzchak amar, leshatya dekaim kame malka, hav leh chamra, ulevatar ema leh, veachze leh, kol innun taavavn deavdat, vechol innun bishin, vehu yete vishabbechach, veyemma dela yishtekach bealma kevavtach. uf hacha, ha kaim daltora tadir kamme malka, yisrael yahavin leh hay doron, uvehay doron pitka, lechol bishin, ulechol taavavn, ulechol chovin deavdu yisrael, vehu ate umeshabbach lehu leyisrael, veitavid sannegora alayyhu, vekudesha berich hu ahdar kolla leresha devishe deammeh, begin dichtiv, (Mishlei 25:22) ki gechalim atta chote al rosho.

Amar ribbi yose, vavy lon leamma deesav, beshaata dehay sair meshaddere lehahu diltora memana dealayyhu, divgineh ate leshabbecha lon leyisrael, vekudesha berich hu ahdar kol innun chovin leresha deammeh, begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay. amar ribbi yehuda, ilmale havo yade umot haolam mehay sair, la shavkin lon leyisrael, yoma chad bealma.

Ta chaze, kol hahu yoma mishtedal ihu behahu sair, uvegin kach kudesha berich hu mechapper lehu leyisrael, vedache lon mikkolla, vela ishtechach kategorya kammeh. levatar, hu ate umeshabbach lehu leyisrael. ucheden shail leh, kema deat amer, vayyomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo, ativ betushebachtayyhu deyisrael, vekategora itavid sanegora veazil leh.

Keden kudesha berich hu amar leshivin sarin desacharin kuresyay, chamittun hay diltora, heach kaim al banay tadir, (istekamu) ha seira chada deishtechach (sefer acher ishtaddar) gabbeh, befitka dechol chovayyhu vechol taavvatayyhu, vechol ma dechatu vechavu kammay, vehu kabbil lon. keden istekamu kullehu, deyahadrun innun chovin al ammeh.

Ribbi abba amar, kol innun chovin vechattain mitdabbekin beh, kema dichtiv, (Micha 7:19) vetashlich bimtzulot yam kol chattotam. ulevatar, kullehu mithadderan bereshehon deammeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:22) venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam el eretz gezera. behay yoma mitattar kahana beitrin illain, vehu kaim ben illae vetattae, umechapper aleh veal beteh, veal kahane, veal makdesha, veal yisrael kullehu.

Tana, beshaata deal bedama defar, mechavvin beresha dimhemnuta, veade beetzbeeh, kema dichtiv, vehiza oto al hakkapporet velifne hakkapporet vehech avid. basim bekifta (sefer acher baketapea) deetzbea, veade kematzlif, betifin deetzbea, lesitre kaftura (sefer acher kateaveraa) (sefer acher kapporta), ade veitkevvavn, veshari lemimne achat, achat veachat. achat bilchodaha, achat (tikun 82 amud alef, raya mehemana 108 amud bet) dechalil kolla, achat shevacha decholla, achat decholla ahadderan lakovlah, achat resha decholla. levatar achat veachat, deinnun sharyayn kachada, biruta beachvavta, vela mitparshan lealmin.

Batar demata lehay veachat, dehi imma decholla. mikkan share lemimne beziuuga, umane veamar, achat ushetayim. achat veshalosh. achat vearba. achat vechamesh. achat vashesh. achat vasheva. begin leamshacha ulenagda lehay achat, dehi imma (yamma) illaa, bedargin yedian, lechitra (sefer acher lenahara leimma) deima tattaa. uleamshacha naharin amikin meatrayyhu likkeneset yisrael. veal da, yoma da teren nehorin naharin kachada, imma illaa nahara leimma tattaa. veal da ketiv yom hakkippurim, kema deittemar.

Amar ribbi yitzchak kiftera chada keshira beragloy dechahana, beshaata dehava al, dei yamut hatam, yappekuhu millevar. uvemma yade. behahu zehorita ityeyda veishtemoda, kad la yehafech gavvnoy. behahi shaata ishtemoda, dechahana ishtechach lego bachattaa. vei yippuk bishlam, bizhorita ityeyda veishtemoda, deyehafech gavvnoy lechivvavr. keden chedvavta hi beillae vetattae. vei lav kullehu ishtechachu betzaara, vahavu yade kolla, dela itkebalu tzelothon.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kevan dehava al, vetimtem enoy dela leistakkela bema dela itzterich, vahava shama kal gadpe keruveyay mezammere umeshabbeche. hava yada kahana, decholla hava bechedva, veyippuk bishlam. veim kol da bitzloteh hava yada, demillin nafkin bechedvavta, umitkabbelan umitbarchan
1237: Kedka yaut, ucheden chedvavta hi beillae vetattae.

Ribbi elazar shaal lerabbi shimon avoy, amar leh, hay yoma amay hu behay atar tale, vela bedarga ochora, deyeot hu lemehevi bedarga demalka share, yattir mikkolla. amar leh ribbi shimon, elazar beri, hachi hu vadday, veyaut shaalta.

Ta chaze, malka kaddisha, shavik hechaleh uveteh bida dematronita, veshavak livnoy immah, begin ledabbera lon, ulealkaa lon, ulemishre begavavyyhu. dei zakkan matronita alat bechedvavta bikara legabbe malka. vei la zakkan, hi veinnun, ithadaru begaluta. veha okimna, kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 19:26) meshadded av yavriach em. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishechem shullecha immechem.

Veal da it yoma chad beshatta, leashgecha behu, uleayyna behu. vechad izdeman hay yoma, imma illaa dechol cheru bidaha, izdeman lokovleh, leistakkela behu beyisrael. veyisrael izderazu behay yoma, bechamma pulechanin, bechamma tzelotin, bechamma innuyin, kullehu bizchuta. keden izdeman lehu cheru, meatar dechol cheru bidaha dematronita. bene malka benaha, deitpakdan bidaha, kullehu zakkain, kullehu bela chataan, bela chovin, keden izdavvevgat (sefer acher vechad izdaman hay yoma veyisrael izdemanu behay yoma bechamma pulechanin bechamma tzelotin bechamma innuyin kullehu bizchuta keden ema illaa dechol cheru bidaha izdammenat lekabbela leistakkela behu beyisrael vechamat bene malka benaha 0 deitpakdan bidaha dematronita kullehu zakkain belo chetin belo chovin keden azemaynat lehu cheru meatar dechol cheru bidaha dematronita keden matronita illaa) legabbe malka, binhiru, bechedva, bishlimu, biruta. deha rabbiat benin lemalka illaa kedka yaut.

Vechad hay yoma la ishtechachu kedka yaut, vavy lon, vavy lishluchehon, vavy deha matronita itrachakat min malka, veima illaa istalakat, vela nafik minnah cheru lealmin. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu olif lon orchoy, begin leishtezava min dina, veyishtachchun zakkain kammeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:30) ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem. uchetiv, (Yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem mikkol tumotechem vegomer.

(Vayikra 23:6) uvachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshevii vegomer. ribbi yose shaal leribbi abba, amar leh, hane chamisha asar yom, may ka mayyre. amar leh, vadday raza yakkira hu. ta chaze, ben leella ben letatta, kol chad vechad, bearcheh natla. uvearcheh yatva, uvearcheh ittear veavid may deavid. hay asor michneset yisrael innun. veyoma asiraa, baasiraa kayyeyma. veal da (Shemot 12:3) beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem ish se levet vegomer. vehay yoma, hu dilah. vachamishsha yomin ochoranin, demalka hu. hahu yoma deate alah. deha chamishshaa, beh yativ malka, bechuresyay. uvechol atar beasor, dematronita hu. chamishsha alayyhu, demalka hu (sefer acher hahu yoma daalah begin dedarga chamishaa beh yativ malka bechuresyay, uvechol atar vechulei). hahu yoma deate alah deha chamishaa be, yativ malka betara.

Uvechol atar beasor dematronita hu, chamisha alayyhu, demalka hu. hahu yoma deate alah. begin kach chamishsha yomin miyarcha, leorayyta. vei tema sheviaa, bezimna ditren avahan mishtakkeche beh, deha malka behu, ucheden mitatter becholla. vechad milla, sheviaa vachamishshaa.

Ta chaze, chamishshaa dileh hu vadday, kema deittemar, ucheden nahir abba leimma, veitnehiru minnah chamshin tarin leanhara lachamishshaa. vei tema sheviaa, begin demalka bishlimu daavahan, vaatara yarit mishsheviaa, kema dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon. veal da bishviaa hu yoma dimattera malka beitroy, ucheden yarit malka leabba veimma, demizdavvevgin kachada. veal da kolla bechad talyay.

(Vayikra 23:6) uvachamishsha asar yom, ribbi yehuda patach, (Bamidbar 21:1) vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad. tanenan, 3 mattenan illain, izdemanu lehu leyisrael, al yede telata achin: moshe, aharon, umiryam. man, bizchut moshe. anane kavod, bizchut aharon. beer, bizchut miryam. vechullehu achidan leella. man bizchut moshe, dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem
1238: Min hashshamayim min hashshamayim (dayyka), da moshe. anane kavod bizchut aharon, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 14:14) asher ayin beayin (aharon) nira atta Adonai vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 16:13) vechissa anan hakketoret. ma lehallan, shiva. af kan name shiva. deha bakketoret shiva ananin mitkashsheran kachada (veod). veaharon resha lechol shiva ananin hu vehu kashir leshit ochoranin beh bechol yoma.

Beer bizchut miryam, deha hi vadday beer itkere. uvesifra deaggadta, (Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok ledea vegomer. da hu beer mayim chayyim, vecholla kishshura chad. meta miryam, istallak beer. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:2) velo haya mayim laeda. uvehahi shaata baat beer ochora leistalleka, dehava shechiach immehon deyisrael. kad chamat shitta ananin dahavo keshirin alah, itkashsherat hi behu.

Mit aharon, istelaku innun ananin, veistallak anana devera immehon. ata moshe, ahdar lehu. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 68:19) alita lammarom shavita shevi lakachta mattanot baadam. lakachta mattanot vadday, innun mattanot dahavo bekadmita beer vaananin.

Beer, da beer deyitzchak. ananim, illen ananim deaharon. amar ribbi yitzchak, mippene ma zacha aharon leda, begin deihu kashir baananim (nusach acher resha laananeym). vehu akshir kol yoma veyoma lechullehu kachada, demitbarchan kullehu al yedoy.

Ta chaze, al kol chesed deavad kudesha berich hu beyisrael. kashir immehon 7 anane yakiran, vekashir lehu bichneset yisrael, deha anana dilah itkeshar beshita ochoranin. uvechullehu shiva, azlu yisrael bemadbera. may taama, begin dechullehu kishra dimhemnuta ninhu veal da bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim. may ka mayyre. begin dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:3) betzillo chimmadti veyashavti ufiryo matok lechikki. uvae bar nash leachazaa garmeh, deyativ techot tzilla dimhemnuta.

Ta chaze, kol innun shenin dekaim aharon, havo yisrael betzilla dimhemnuta, techot illen ananin. batar demit aharon, istallak anana chad, dehu yemina decholla. vechad hay istallak, istelaku kol shear immeh (nusach acher ananin) veitchaziu kullehu bigriuta. veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:29) vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon. al tikre vayyiru, ella vayyiru. miyyad vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad yoshev hannegev ki va yisrael derech haatarim. shema deistalaku innun ananim, umit tayayra ravreva dechol innun ananim itkeshsharu beh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, hakkenaani melech arad yoshev hannegev vadday. vechad atu innun meallelin deshadar moshe, amru (Bamidbar 13:29) amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev, begin letavra libbayyhu. deha baamalek attebar chelehon bekadmita.

Amar ribbi abba, vayyishma hakkenaani, may ka mayyre hacha. batar deistelaku innun ananim. ella kenaan ketiv beh, (Bereshit 9:25) vayyomer arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav. hacha olifna, man deappik garmeh mitztzila dimhemnuta, itchaze lemehevi eved leavadde avaddin, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:1) vayyillachem beyisrael vayishb mimmennu shevi. hu natal avaddin miyisrael legarmeh.

Veal da ketiv, kol haezrach beyisrael yeshvu basukkot. kol man deihu misharsha vegiza kaddisha deyisrael, yeshvu bassukkot, techot tzilla dimhemnuta. uman deleteh miggiza veshorsha kaddisha deyisrael, la yetiv behu, veyippuk garmeh mittechot tzilla dimhemnuta.

Ketiv (Hoshea 12:8) kenaan beyado mozne mirma, da eliezer eved avraham. veta chaze, ketiv arur kenaan uvegin dezacha kenaan da, leshammesha leavraham, kevan deshimmesh leavraham, yetiv techot tzilla dimhemnuta, zacha lemeppak mehahu latyay deitlatteyay, velo od ella dichtiv beh beracha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:31) vayomer bo beruch Adonai. may ka mayyre. dechol man deyetiv techot tzilla dimhemnuta, achasin cheru leh velivnoy lealmin, veitberach birchata illaa, uman deappik garmeh metzilla dimhemnuta, achasin galuta leh velivnoy, dichtiv vayyillachem beyisrael vayyishb mimmennu shevi.
1239: (Vayikra 23:42) bassukkot teshvu chaser, veda anana chad, dechullehu keshirin beh. dichtiv, ki anan Adonai alehem yomam. uchetiv, (Bamidbar 14:14) uveammud anan atta holech lifnehem yomam. da hu anana deaharon, deikre yomam, dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. anana chad, natil immeh chamesh ochoranin, veinnun shit. vaanana ochora, dichtiv uveammud esh layla, da nahara lehu leyisrael, minhiru deinnun shit.

Raya mehemna (Vayikra 23:42) bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim vegomer, pikkuda (45) da, leshev bassukka. veha okimna, begin leitchazaa deyisrael yatve beraza dimhemnuta, bela dechilu kelal, deha mekatrega itperash minnayyhu. vechol man deihu beraza dimhemnuta, yativ bassukka. kema deokimna, dichtiv, kol haezrach beyisrael yishvu bassukkot. man deihu beraza dimhemnuta, umizzara vesharsha deyisrael, yishvu bassukkot. veraza da ittemar bechamma duchete.

Pikkuda (46) batar da, lekarva karbena bechol yoma, vekarbena da, lemehevi chulaka becholla, bechedvavta divnoy. begin dechullehu achidan beilana. anfin diltatta dilgabbe sharsha deilana, kolla itbarchan begin ilana. af al gav delet behu toalta, kolla itbarchan. vechedvavta deyisrael baavuhon dilella, yahave chulaka devirkan, lechol innun shear ammin, deit lon achidu, veitachadu behu beyisrael.

Vechol illen karbenin, lemehav mezona, leinnun memanan dishar ammin, deha miggo rechimu deka rachim kudesha berich hu livnoy, bae decholla yehon rechimin dilhon. veraza da, (Mishlei 16:7) birtztzot Adonai darche ish gam oyvav yashlim itto. afillu kol innun mekatrege illae kullehu ahadderan rechimin leyisrael vechad chayyaylin dilella ahadru rechimin leyisrael, kol innun diltatta, al achat kama vechamma.

Vei tema lehon havo mekarve karbena, lav hachi, ella kolla lekudesha berich hu salik umitkarev. veihu parish mezona lechullehu uchelusin desitrin ochoranin, deyithanun behahu dorona divnoy, veyithadrun rechimin dilhon, deyindeun ella vetatta, deha let amma keamma deyisrael, deinnun chulakeh veadveh dekudesha berich hu, veistallak yekara dekudesha berich hu ella vetatta kedka yaut. vechol uchelusin illain patche veamre, (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz. (tikkunin daf 152) (ad kan raya mehemana)

Ribbi elazar patach (veamar), (Yirmeyahu 2:2) ko amar Adonai zacharti lach chesed neurayich vegomer. hay kera al keneset yisrael ittemar, beshaata dahavat azla bemadbera immehon deyisrael. zacharti lach chesed: da anana deaharon, denatla bechamesh ochoranin, deitkesharu alach, unehiru alach. ahavat kelulotayich, deishtachlalu lach, (sefer acher vechullehu ishtachlelu bach) veattaru lach, veatkinu lach kechalla detade tachshitaha. vechol kach lamma. begin lechtech acharay bammidbar beeretz lo zerua.

Ta chaze, beshaata devar nash yativ bemadora da, tzilla dimhemnuta, shechinta parsa gadfaha aleh milleella, veavraham vachamishsha tzaddikayyay ochoranin shavyayn madorehon immeh. amar ribbi abba, avraham vachamishsha tzaddikayyay, vedavid malka, shavyayn madorehon immeh. hada hu dichtiv, bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim. shivat yamim ketiv, vela beshivat yamim. kegavvna da ketiv, (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim vegomer. uvae bar nash lemechde bechol yoma veyoma, beanpin nehirin, beushepizin illen desharyayn immeh.

Veamar ribbi abba, ketiv bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim, ulevatar yeshvu bassukkot. bekadmita teshvu, ulevatar yeshvu. ella, kadmaa leushepize. tinyayna, livne alma. kadmaa leushepize, ki ha derav hamenuna sava, kad hava ayel lassukka hava chadde, vekaim al pitcha lassukka millegav, veamar nezammen leushepizin. mesadder (nusach acher nisdar) patora, vekaim al raglohi, umevarech, veomer bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim. tivu ushepizin illain, tivu. tivu ushepize mehemnuta, tivu. arim (sefer acher asche) yedoy, vechadde, veamar zakkaa chullakana, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo vegomer, vahava yativ.
